Session 1, 2 - Welcome to Longdale Part 1, 2
sessions.content_html:
• We meet the party on a trade ship. Everyone was hired by the Longdale Corridor Trading Company to assist in the transport of goods to Longdale.
  • Here are the members of our party:
    • Dagwyn Koehlanna - A sneaky rogue, always up to no good.
    • Voroth - A righteous paladin and knight serving his kingdom.
    • Gynnie Greenbottle - A sassy old lady whose sass is only outclassed by her desire to make a quick coin.
    • Fen'Harel - A druid of the Moonstar Grove, out to see the world for the first time.
  • During their trip, the boat was attacked by a gang of musical pirates called the Sonnet Swashbucklers. Their emblem is denoted by a coupled eighth note with skull and crossbones for the notes.
  • The party is able to defend the ship, and fend off the band of pirates.

sessions.title: Session 3 - Welcome to Longdale Part 3
sessions.content_html:
• Upon disembarking at the Longdale docks, the Longdale Corridor Trading Company is satisfied with the party's work, and want to rehire them to investigate these pirates, and to find a more permanent solution to the increased number of pirate attacks.
  • In Longdale, Dagwyn vanishes after a failed attempt to steal some goods from locals around the town; the party meets and teams up with another friendly Paladin named Prim. Together they head north into the forest to confront a group of bandits said to have information on the pirates' leader Songbeard the Pirate.
  • They are able to defeat the bandits and learn about a cave hideout to the south of Longdale along the coast. They is said to be where Songbeard is operating his band of pirates.

sessions.title: Session 4 - Welcome to Longdale Part 4
sessions.content_html:
• The party travels back to Longdale and continues south along the coast until they reach Songbeard's hideout.
  • They sneak into the lair to confront Songbeard only to find all of the pirate henchmen have been slaughtered, and Songbeard lays dying before them at the end of the hideout.
  • He warns them of a great impending catastrophe is about to unfold, and directs the party of a bag of things to aid them before dying.

Songbeard's Gift

  • 2 Potions of Flying
  • Decanter of Endless Water
  • Sending Stones
  • 1 Amethyst Gem
  • His necklace, which has a key-shaped pendant. The base of the key is a skull with ruby encrusted in the eyes.

sessions.title: Session 5 - Demon Rift Incident Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• The party leaves the cave to head back to Longdale and warn the town and try to get more information.
  • On their way back, they are ambushed by a dark shadow demon in the forest. Things aren't looking good until they are rescued by a pair of forest-dwellers: A ranger named Ethiul and a druid named Esther.
  • Together, they are able to defeat the shadow demon.

sessions.title: Session 6 - Demon Rift Incident Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• Ethiul tells the party that the calamity they are about to face is a massive flood of demons from his Homeland far to the west over the sea. A rift had been opened (Events of Group 3, Arc 1) that forced them to flee east in search of help.
  • When everyone returns back to Longdale, Prim and Gynnie go their separate ways from the rest of the party.
  • Attempts to warn the townfolk initially do not go well. Most people do not believe in this Calamity, however, the people of the West Longdale Trading Company listen, just due to how much the party had helped them in the past, but the rest of the townsfolk are not convinced.

sessions.title: Session 7 - Demon Rift Incident Part 3
sessions.content_html:
• Ultimately, the party decides to flee to the east on their journey to keep warning other towns and villages along the way. They can't convince everyone, but they want to do what they can to warn those who are willing to listen.
  • The next village they arrive at a few days later is called Riverside Crossing.
  • There, the party meets a priestess that believes them, and is willing to help.
  • She tells them that she knows of some ruins in the forest a few hours north of the village.
  • They night in the tavern, the party meets an elf named Tassarion.
  • He is a Celestial Warlock who has made a pact with the celestials to gain the strength necessary to defeat the demons flooding in from inferno and wants to help the party.

sessions.title: Session 8 - Demon Rift Incident Part 4
sessions.content_html:
• The party begins to travel around town attempting to warn the townsfolk of the impending calamity.
  • They meet a priestess in town that believes them, and wants to help.
  • She directs them into the forest to the north. There they can find the ruins to a temple that is purported to contain an infernal tome. It's an unholy site near the town that is seen as cursed and typically avoided by the village hunters.
  • On their way in search of the ruins, the party encounters an ambush by goblins, but swiftly defeat them, and they flee the scene.
  • Following their trail, the party happens upon the goblin's camp, where they are conducting a funeral for their fallen friend.
  • The whole scene is rather awkward for the party, but they get what they are looking for, and are able to leave and continue searching for the ruins.

sessions.title: Session 9, 10 - Demon Rift Incident Part 5, 6
sessions.content_html:
• As the party continues searching for the ruins, they continue north, wandering throughout the forest.
  • As they continue, several skeletons rise up along with a couple of shadow-y manifestations.
  • The party is able to swiftly defeat them. The stronger demons seem to leave behind gems when they are killed that then party collects.
  • One of the skeleton's body's is a journal belonging to someone named "Gerald Williams"
  • The journal entry indicates that Gerald was on an expedition to find a tome that prophesized a great Calamity that will one day strike. He was hired by a mysterious person named "The Amber Stone"

sessions.title: Session 11 - Demon Rift Incident Part 7
sessions.content_html:
• The party continues, they eventually discover an altar, which is ruined and fairly overgrown. Atop the altar there is a slot for a gemstone or other small object. Upon the altars stone base there are many mysterious infernal markings in red. The faintest of dissonant whispers begin to occupy the minds of the party.
  • Upon touching the altar, two skeletal minotaurs rise from the ground besides the base of the altar.
  • Once the minotaurs fall, their infernal essence begins whisking away from the illuminated bones and into the altar causing it to partially open
  • Pushing their way inside, the staircase down into the crypt eventually leads to an open chamber with a pedestal at the end of it.
  • On this pedestal is the tome they are looking for! However, removing the tome from the pedestal triggered a trap, and the undead littered throughout the crypt's floor suddenly awaken.
  • Overwhelmed, the party flees and is barely able to escape the partially opened dungeon door, closing the undead in after escaping.

sessions.title: Session 12 - Demon Rift Incident Part 8
sessions.content_html:
• The next morning, the party returns back to Riverside Crossing with the tome in hand, tattered and exhausted.
  • They deliver the tomb to the priestess and she begins her research into its secrets.
  • Not long into this process, the sky is overtaken with dark clouds and turns to a red hue
  • The rivers begin flowing red with blood. An invasion from the west is inevitable!
  • The Priestess says to flee and meet her at a city to the east called Raeneros City. To ensure their trust, she gives the part 1000 GP and 4 potions of greater invisibility
  • Reluctant at first, Voroth eventually comes to accept that they are all in this together, and accepts
  • Before parting ways, she tells the party that the only thing she could decipher is that there are more types of demonic heart gems.
  • In particular, there are 4 kinds of greater demonic heart gems that she thinks could prove useful based on how much they appear in the book.
    • Heart of Wrath (Red)
    • Heart of Sloth (Blue)
    • Heart of Greed (Yellow)
    • Heart of Envy (Green)

sessions.title: Session 13 - Demon Rift Incident Part 9
sessions.content_html:
• The priestess and the party part ways. The party use their potions of greater invisibility to quietly flee after a massive wave of demons overtakes their region.
  • Partway through their travels east towards Raeneros City, though, an ambush of enemies strikes!
  • The party defeats them, and continues eastward.

sessions.title: Session 14, 15 - Demon Rift Incident Part 10, 11
sessions.content_html:
• Eventually, after several day's travel, the party arrives at the outskirts of Raeneros City. There are a few streets lined with housing, shops, ports, etc. all servicing the city.
  • After searching for a bit, they eventually find the priestess among a small congregation of Sulis worshipers.
  • They say they have learned more from having a few more days with the tome.
  • In order to obtain the heart of Wrath, she says she can perform a ritual to combine the lesser demonic soul gems the party has been collecting from defeating the various demons they have encountered in the past.
  • They all hike into the forest a few miles to perform the ritual.
  • This summons a large, much more powerful demon compared to anything they have fought prior.
  • The party is able to defeat the wrathful demon, and obtain the Heart of Wrath.

sessions.title: Session 16 - Demon Rift Incident Part 12
sessions.content_html:
• With the Heart of Wrath in had, the party wants to enter the city for refuge, and to seek additional help from the Alderman of the city to solve this problem.
  • As they approach the bridge and main gate, they notice a massive line of refugees, and a lot of crowding.
  • There are also a lot of guards posted at the gate, more that normal.
  • The guards state that they are unable to accept any additional refugees.
  • Through some clever trickery, Tassarion is able to turn invisible, and trick the guards into granting the party passage into the city.
  • Upon entering the big city, Fen gets nervous because she has never been in a city like this before, so she wild shapes into a mouse and hides in Voroth's pocket.

sessions.title: Session 17 - Demon Rift Incident Part 13
sessions.content_html:
• The party makes their way uphill towards the innermost ring of the city. Once inside, the guards were much more receptive to their cause.
  • Eventually they make their way into the city palace, and here they meet Alderman Jeremiah.
  • They exchange information about the hearts and about some of the contents of the tome.
  • Jeremiah tells them about a battle they fought to the south of the city and takes the party into another room.
  • He pulls back a curtain, and reveals hundreds of soldiers from that battle that have all been petrified into stone.
  • He reveals that they all fell to a demon that they eventually defeated, and obtained a blue gem.
  • The party knows this gem to be the Heart of Sloth; therefore, they have 2 of 4 total gems required
  • A few days have passed since the party arrived at the palace. The Priestess and the City's (extremely old) High Mage have discovered that the gems are used in a summoning ritual to open a portal to the infernal plane.
  • After studying the ritual, they believe the stones can be used to perform a modified version of the ritual that can open to any plane of their choosing.

sessions.title: Session 18 - Demon Rift Incident Part 14
sessions.content_html:
• The party is summoned back into the Alderman's war room after a few days.
  • He tells them that they may have located the Heart of Greed, but according to the book, it would be in a temple ruin that has likely been buried years ago.
  • The High Mage says that he can perform a teleportation spell to try and transport them into the temple. He also gives the party a recall stone capable of returning them to the palace.
  • The party gets teleported underground to the entrance of the temple.
  • The first puzzle of the temple was a draw bridge with a pit. The draw bridge was up, and could be lowered by pouring gold coins down the pit.
  • The party poured everything down the pit and crossed into the next room of the temple.
  • The second room of the temple is an eldritch casino, with slot machines and card tables all operated by nearly invisible spirits.
  • Everyone in the party wants no part of this, so after inspecting the machines and playing slots once, they try to open the door into the next room and it opens.
  • The final room was filled with thousands of various kinds of coins.
  • In the center of the room sits the Heart of Greed on a pedestal with a grate that leads to running water below in front of the gemstone. Inscribed is a message stating to "pay" what you think is fair for the gem.
  • The party then proceeded to dump all the extra money through the grate into the running water below.
  • Right before finishing, someone touched the Heart of Greed, and all remaining coins in the room instantly flew to the heart forming it into a Coin Golem.
  • The Coin Golem however, was extremely week due to the party keeping practically no gold throughout their traversal into the temple.
  • They are able to swiftly defeat the Coin Golem, activate the return stone, and return the the palace with 3/4 gems obtained.

sessions.title: Session 19 - Demon Rift Incident Part 15
sessions.content_html:
• Upon their return to the Palace of Raeneros, a courier arrived warning that the big wave is arriving. This is the same wave that slammed Riverside Crossing about a week prior.
  • In order to prepare for this battle, the Alderman's armory offered a selection of a few magic items to the party.
  • The party made their way down from the Palace to the outer ring, and eventually to one of the main gates.
  • With the guards, they stand facing to the west waiting for the impending wave of black and red to approach

sessions.title: Session 20 - Demon Rift Incident Part 16
sessions.content_html:
• The battle begins. The party faces the first wave of demons and defeats them swiftly, but then everyone is overcome by darkness.
  • Everyone awakens in their own separate shadow dimension confronted by a shadow-y copy of themselves.
  • After each party member defeats their copy, they receive a fragmented green shard.
  • After each victory, that person wakes up on the ground in a cloud of shadows among everyone else. Those who have not defeated their shadow copy have shadow essence covering their eyes and mouth.
  • Party memebers that are out can jump back into some else's shadow dimension and aid them in battle.
  • One the party members have all defeated the battle begins to simmer down.
  • One final wave of enemies approaches, and the party, exhausted, have to give everything to defeat them.

sessions.title: Session 21 - One Wish
sessions.content_html:
• The party returns back to the Palace after the battle.
  • The priestess and High Mage inform the party that they are able to perform a ritual that can combine the obtained shards together into the Heart of Envy.
  • The priestess synthesizes the Heart of Envy, and with all 4 hearts obtained, the Priestess and High Mage declare that they will perform a modified version of the ritual to open a portal to Celestia, the celestial plane.
  • There, the party can enter and ask the celestials for aid in this calamity.
  • In Celestia, the party is greeted by cautious celestial guards. Tassarion, being a celestial warlock, explains their situation.
  • They take the party to a nearby altar, and ask them to sacrifice an item of great importance to them each in order to summon a goddess for help.
  • Once this is done, the summoning ritual summons the Goddess Nila Aashni, the demigoddess and child of the God of Celestia "Star Platinum" in the form of a purple spectral dragon
  • For such sacrifices, she offers to grant them one wish if they can prove what they can prove their righteous intent and prove their worth as warriors and adventurers.
  • The party fights the purple dragon form (Young Blue Dragon stats) and defeats it.
  • In a flash of light she reappears in the form of a biblically accurate angel and offers to grant them one wish.
  • After a lengthy debate, the party nominates Voroth to utter the following wish:
We wish for the portal to the infernal plane in [INSERT CITY NAME HERE] to have never existed
  • Everything fades to white.

sessions.title: Session 22 - Welcome to the Main Timeline
sessions.content_html:
• Voroth re-meets Fen and Ethiul in the Gatekeeper Inn Tavern
  • Voroth and Fen get a mutual vision "Find Her" and "Find Him" respectively
  • Big burly men, members of the Melodic Marauders show up to shake down Voroth
  • Among them is Tassarion; a battle ensues, but Tassarion eventually turns on his companions and joins to assist Voroth.
  • LEVEL UP (6)

sessions.title: Session 23 - Find Her Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• Party after the battle sees a flash of light with another vision all getting the same voice saying "Find Her". Voroth sees the flash of a priestess of a town he's unfamiliar with.
  • This is the priestess of a town called Riverside (from the first arc). She has distinct locks/highlights of emerald green hair.
  • Party goes to the MoonStar grove to ask the elders for help.

sessions.title: Session 24 - Find Her Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• Party runs into a sketchy guy in a tavern at Riverside Crossing who knows of the person they are talking about. She is not a cleric (in this timeline), but the former leader of the Sonnet Swashbucklers. The region is host to several musical pirate factions, the most notable of which are the:
    • Sonnet Swashbucklers
    • Melodic Marauders
    • Bardic Brigands
    • Concerto Corsairs
  • The mysterious man has a letter from Melody Songstrike that he believes contains information helpful to locating her. He will trade it for a Harmony Medallion: a magic item that can be obtained from a Siren and will meet them in Saltmarsh in a week to exchange the items.
  • Tells them the best place to start looking is to search around the small shanty town on the north shore of the region

sessions.title: Session 25 - Enter Morgan!
sessions.content_html:
• The party travels to the shanty town.
  • It is pretty run down and only contains fishers and criminals living in borderline wretched conditions.
  • Here they meet a man named Morgan, a former member of the Sonnet Swashbucklers and Bastard son of Songbeard the Pirate.
  • He agrees to help them fight the Siren and obtain the Harmony Medallion, since he also knew Melody Songstrike and wants to talk to her to learn more about the demise of his father after his banishment from the faction.

sessions.title: Session 26 - Beware, Sirens Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• Party makes their way over to the Siren's rock.
  • On the way there they fight some of the Siren's cronies in the water.
  • Once they reach the Siren's rock initiative begins.

sessions.title: Session 27 - Beware, Sirens Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• The party fought and defeated the Siren, obtaining a pile of loot and magic items, as well as the Harmony Medallion they needed for the exchange with the mysterious man in Saltmarsh
  • LEVEL UP (7)

Siren Loot

  • Harmony Medallion
  • Magic Earplugs
  • Pearl of Power
  • 2571 GP
  • 4167 SP
  • 652 CP
  • 2 Gold Bracelets (worth ~25 GP each)
  • Silver Necklace with an amethyst pendant (~30 GP)

sessions.title: Session 28 - Find Her Part 3
sessions.content_html:
• The party rested and resupplied on rations the next morning in the small tavern.
  • They travel to the port town of Saltmarsh, into the local Gatekeeper's Inn
  • They find the mysterious man there, as expected, and go upstairs to exchange the items.
  • Once they exchange the items, touching the letter reveals the strongest vision yet, that affects everyone except for Morgan (since he wasn't part of the original timeline jump)
  • This vision reveals in precise detail a tiny island followed vividly by the words "Find Her", showing one particular tiny house on that island.
  • The party now knows where Melody Songstrike is.

sessions.title: Session 29 - Find Her Part 4
sessions.content_html:
• Opening the letter reveals her intent to retire from the Sonnet Swashbucklers immediately following the death of Songbeard.
  • Tassarion then commands the mysterious man to leave the town so he can steal back the Harmony Medallion.
  • To celebrate, the party creates a massive rager at the Gatekeeper's Inn with the following notable events occurring:
    • Everyone drinks some shots and drinks at the bar to start off.
    • Morgan bumps into and angers dwarf, who he offers a free drink to make up.
    • Fen passes a performance check to play some nasty beat-boxing flute with the tavern bard playing their lute as a rhythmic backup.
    • Morgan tries to rizz up a looker in the crowd, but gets rejected.
    • Voroth keeps drinking and collapses through a table.
    • Tessarion passes a performance check to rap in autotune and performs with Fen.
    • Ethiul rolls NAT 20 perception and instantly senses the penis length of every Dragonborn in the room.
    • Morgan, feeling dejected and rejected turns into the Party's room early.
    • Ethiul successfully rizzes and seduces one of the dragonborn patrons of the tavern, and they go upstairs for the night. They enter the same room as Morgan.
    • Tassarion semi-successfully rizzes the same looker in the crowd
    • The next morning it is revealed that the dwarf Morgan treated to a drink began putting rounds for the whole tavern on HIS tab.
  • Morgan goes to the dwarf's forge/storefront and shakes him down for spending his money. He's able to get a +1 rapier from him as a result.
  • The party then decides to leave for the MoonStar Grove to ask for more guidance on the vivid vision they had.

sessions.title: Session 30 - Bidrian's Biddings
sessions.content_html:
• Everyone gains inspiration from last session because it was funny and impromptu
  • The elders at the grove reveal that the best way they can find answers to where or what the location in the vision might be, they should go to the city and seek a powerful wizard that can help them identify or transport to different locations.
  • From here, the party travels to Raeneros City and are able to obtain passage into the middle ring, where they find a magic items shop and tower called "Bidrian's Biddings".
  • Tassarion buys another Harmony medallion, Morgan gets a Medallion of mimickry.
  • Jobidrian reveals a prized piece of his collection: a purported original work from Johann Sea-Bastion Bach: Rhapsody of Haste and asks Voroth if he can identify anything about it, but Voroth can't and he gets mad at Jobidrian because he doesn't care about music.
  • They then negotiate to get teleportation services to and from the location from the vision. Jobidrian performs the teleportation.

sessions.title: Session 31 - Enter Melody!
sessions.content_html:
• Since it was just a description, there is a miss and the party TPs to a nearby island instead: dickbutt island.
  • After catching their bearing, Ethiul and Fen turn into sharks that Tassarion and Voroth can ride with Morgan waterskiing on the back
  • They arrive at the island that matches their visions after swimming for a few miles. The locals are all really nice and chill surfer dudes.
  • They enter and meet Melody Songstrike. She explains that she left the Sonnet Swashbucklers out of fear for her safety. She thinks someone within staged a coup to obtain the keys to Songbeard's treasure: The Two Piece, and take it for themselves.
  • Then she reveals that she is Morgan's true mother, and that Morgan having the sand charm means he was the one chosen as a the heir to the Two Piece.
  • She gives the party the Compass of the Homesick and explains that the compass and sand charm are the two pieces needed to find the Two Piece.
  • She gives Fen a +2 Moon Sickle with an inscription of Moon Druids which is an heirloom to her former grove before their forceful relocation and merging with Ethiul's commune.
  • Before the party leaves, she says that their paths will cross again, and to find her engagement ring which she believes to be part of the treasure
  • She also says NOT to trust the Sonnet Swashbucklers.
  • The party uses their teleport scroll to teleport back to Bidrian's Biddings.

sessions.title: Session 32 - Search for the Two Piece Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• The party goes to a neighboring tavern to buy more rations from a nice Canadian sounding tavern keep
  • They also began to strategize the search for the Two Piece.

sessions.title: Session 33 - Search for the Two Piece Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• Ethiul and Voroth went to the Enchanted Ass-ylum. Ethiul got a #1 and Voroth got a #2 (pop rocks).
  • Tassarion contacted a group of Melodic Marauders, telling them he thinks he has a means of finding the Two Piece.
  • After making a deal with the ship's captain: Captain Barry Tone, a group of Sonnet Swashbucklers arrived to convince the party to take them to the treasure instead.
  • They say that Melody Songstrike is a traitor, and that the Sonnet Swashbucklers are the rightful heir to the Two Piece.
  • They want to recover a specific magic item for their new leader purported to be within the two piece: a magic item with ties to Johann Sea-Bastion Bach.
  • The party decides to travel with the Sonnet Swashbucklers instead of the Melodic Marauders cautious of their intentions, but wanting a better deal with the treasure.
  • Outraged, Captain Barry Tone attacked, but conceded after a fireball destroyed a large portion of his ship.
  • LEVEL UP (8)

sessions.title: Session 34 - Search for the Two Piece Part 3
sessions.content_html:
• The party set sail in the direction of the compass into the Sea of Cascades.
  • The navigator sang a melancholic musical number under the moon and stars.
  • The party participated in a gambling game with other crew members to pass the time while they sailed towards the treasure.

sessions.title: Session 35 - Search for the Two Piece Part 4
sessions.content_html:
• The party arrives at an island with a small beach, the compass points directly to a recess in the cliffside.
  • The area seems to be infested with Giant Crabs, so Fen wild shapes into a giant crab herself to go and investgate.
  • There is a massive underground structure housing dozens, if not hundreds of giant crabs all servicing their queen.
  • The queen is revealed to be a gargantuan Storm Crab assigned as a magical protectorate of the treasure.
  • The party battles and defeats the beast. Shortly after they find Sogbeard's treasure

Songbeard's Treasure

  • 5000 GP
  • 4 Potions of Greater Healing
  • 1 Potion of Mind Reading
  • 1 Revivify Spell Scroll
  • Cape of the Mountebank - Morgan
  • Gauntlets of Ogre Power - Tassarion
  • Belt of Dwarvenkind - Ethiul
  • Staff of Healing - Fen
  • Bracers of Defense - Voroth
  • Ship in a bottle

sessions.title: Session 36 - Search for the Two Piece Part 5
sessions.content_html:
• Morgan uncorked the bottle to the ship in a bottle, which released a pulse of magic energy.
  • Luckily Ethiul was able to throw off Cleff from their trail by lying to him about what it was (nat 20 smh).
  • After this, Voroth was able to secretly identify that the ship in the bottle is actually a magic item called the Ship of Theseus.
  • Voroth was also able to suppress the magical presence of the compass and reoriented it to point towards the source of the sand that was in the bottle.
  • With a new objective and a boat to get there, the party waited until night to slip out of the cargo hold and abandon ship. They did so with acute stealth, a few wild shapes, and some invisibility.
  • Once off the ship they waited until it was sufficiently far away before activating the Ship of Theseus, and set course for the new direction of the compass.
  • Given the size of the ship and the lack of experience most party members have sailing, they will have to work exhaustingly hard to maintain the ship's course.
  • Eventually, the party spots an island in the distance; that's where the treasure must be!

sessions.title: Session 37 - Search for the Two Piece Part 6
sessions.content_html:
• The party arrived at the site of the second location of the two piece.
  • They spent some time surveying the area and making absolutely sure that there are no traps or guardians like last time.
  • After they collected and inventoried the treasure, they struggled to push the treasure back to the dingy and made their way back to the Ship of Theseus.
  • On the ship there are signs of other people present. In the Captain's quarters, Captain Lyra Strummings is there along with First Mate Cleff, and a few other cronies (2 bandit captains, 1 mage) to confront the party.
  • She introduces herself to Captain Austin Otto: He has a proposition after revealing a bound Melody Songstrike.
  • He reveals that he knew all along they were traveling with Morgan and urges the party to leave the baton for them.
  • He says things like "You failed the Sonnet Swashbucklers, Melody deserted the Sonnet Swashbucklers, and now you're trying to usurp a treasure that doesn't belong to you OR Melody." and "Think about what your sister would want: she would want us every opportunity to reclaim his treasure and use it to enact justice on those that betrayed Songbeard."
  • Morgan lashes out and shaters the Emerald Gem releasing a Water Elemental; roll for initiative!

Songbeard's Second Treasure:

  • 2 lb Silver Bars x200 (2000 GP)
  • 2 lb Gold Bars x100 (10000 GP)
  • Baton of Johann Sea-Bastion Bach
  • Sheet music for Movement 2: Overture of the Phantom Crew.
  • Letter explaining the item combination and loosely describing what the Baton is capable of.
  • Skull Key that invokes visions of when Songbeard died in the original timeline and gave them the same item.
  • What seems like a paperweight in the shape of a gear. (The Clockwork Pendant)
  • Destroyed Journal that contains two readable journal entries:
A hidden treasure, veiled in the enigma of existence, beckons me with a siren's call. In my rumination, I have unearthed two paths to the coveted truth—a wish, woven from the very fabric of dreams, or the possession of a mystical relic known as "The Divine Magistrate's Embrace.

Whence did my musings lead me but to the fabled Crosa City Grand Auction, where fortunes are bartered amidst whispered secrets. There, amidst the clamor of eager bidders, I seek the elusive artifact that holds the power to unveil the veracity of this elusive treasure's existence.
In shadows deep, where moonlight weaves,
A tale of love, my heart deceives.
Lady Songstrike, fair and free,
A siren's call, a melody.

Through storms we sailed, our ship so grand,
Sonnet Swashbucklers, hand in hand.
Yet, in the heart, a tempest brews,
A conflict fierce, love's bitter dues.

For Songbeard fears the ties that bind,
The vows that love and duty find.
To wed my love, or rule the seas,
A choice that leaves me ill at ease.

The ship of love, a treacherous sea,
Where duty clashes with the heart's decree.
For Sonnet Swashbucklers to thrive,
Must we risk our love to keep it alive?

A pirate's heart, burdened with care,
Yearns for love, yet dreads the snare.

  • "The Divine Magistrate's Embrace" can also be used to learn the truth of Voroth's Visions.
  • The poem reveals Songbeard's intent to be married with Melody, but not wanting to due to the pressures of them also co-running the Sonnet Swashbucklers

sessions.title: Session 38 - Vs. Sonnet Swashbucklers!
sessions.content_html:
• The party fought Austin Otto, Lyra Strummings, and the other members of the sonnet swashbucklers.
  • The battle resulted in the death of Captain Austin Otto. The party also captured Cleff, but Captain Lyra Strummings escaped on her ship.

sessions.title: Session 39 - Found Her
sessions.content_html:
• After everything settles down for a bit, Tassarion takes out the baton and conducts the movement again. This spawns the phantom crew which gets to work preparing the ship and hauling up the dingy with the treasure.
  • Then Morgan takes Cleff into the captain's quarters and convinces him to join the party's crew.
  • Through this questioning, we learn that:
    • Lyra and Austin followed them probably using some scrying spell.
    • Their task was to obtain the baton at any cost, but they wanted to do it diplomatically because they are intimidated by the party's strength and didn't have many numbers.
    • He doesn't know who the leader of the Sonnet Swashbucklers is, they have been very secretive since obtaining power, but after learning from Morgan that Melody Songstrike is alive, he suggests she knows who this person would be because she was the leader following Songbeard's assasination.
  • When the party takes a long rest, Voroth, Fen, Ethiul, and Tassarion receive a dream vision together in a liminal space with a disembodied voice:
    • It says: "Excellent work. You found her, and she lead you to Songbeard's Treasure. What will you do next?"
    • Voroth asks: "What should we do next?"
    • The voice responds: "You must do what I have always ask you to do: Find her again."
    • Voroth discerns that this "Vision" is much more vivid and detailed than past visions. Could the skull key that we obtained (that Songbeard wanted Voroth to have) be the means for this elevated level of communication?
  • The next morning, the party wakes up to Cleff cooking breakfast, ready to set sail towards what lies next.
  • LEVEL UP (9)

sessions.title: Session 40 - The Cosmic Vangaurds Call Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• Cleff asks the party what they are going to do next.
  • Everyone wants to head back to Raenaros City to gear up.
  • Cleff warns them that they should avoid the harbor because of the Sonnet Swashbucklers being on the lookout for them.
  • The party snuck in through the north gate and made their way to the middle ring. The next morning, everyone stocked up on rations, weapons, armour, and spell scrolls.
  • After an exchange with Jobidrian, he learned more about the works of Johan Sea-Bastion Bach and vowed to help the party look for works. He wants to hear the full concerto from end to end before he dies.
  • Cleff hired a carriage and provisions to get the party to the MoonStar Grove.
  • There, Ethiul learns that it is his time to become a Cosmic Vanguard. To do so there are 3 rites of passage.
  • The first rite involves him getting a magic cosmic tattoo called the Lifewell Tattoo. The second is a quest to find a Robe of Constellations: a relic worn a used by Cosmic Vangaurds of the Past. The third is a trial put on by the elders. Succeeding the trial will prove Ethiul worthy, and bestow upon him an artifact. Between the three rites, Ethiul's journey will be complete and he will be a fully realized Cosmic Vanguard. There he will meet the Starmother for guidance with this newfound power and responsibility.

sessions.title: Session 41 - The Cosmic Vangaurds Call Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• That night at the grove, another set of vivid visions occurs
  • The voice again asks "Will you find her?" and says things like "She is the key that holds all the answers you seek"
  • The party decides to head back to Raenaros City in order to ask Jobidrian if he knows anything about a "Robe of Constellations".
  • On their way back, the party stops at the Gatekeeper's Inn at Riverside Crossing
  • Ethiul finds a set of dragonborn twins in the back of the tavern and attempts to rizz them up with the help of Fen
  • They go upstairs to do the deed, but oh no, they we actually two shapechanged incubi!
  • The party defeats them, saves the tavern, and the next morning, takes a carriage escort towards Raeneros City

sessions.title: Session 42 - The Cosmic Vangaurds Call Part 3
sessions.content_html:
• The party is leaning towards calling themselves the "Rhythmic Rizzlers"
  • The party makes their way back to Bidrian's Biddings. Ethiul asks him for more information regarding the Robe of Constellations
  • Jobidrian says he happens to have just the right books; many years ago, he helped someone much like Ethiul, and probably from the same grove, in their quest to become a Cosmic Vanguard. He asks if Ethiul or Fen knows her, but they don't.
  • He has two books about it, one about the Robe of Constellations, and the other about the Upper Planes. From what he has read, he thinks the Robe presents itself to those who have been touched by the cosmic energy of the upper planes.
  • Read the passages from the books.
  • Jobidrian says he has to close the shop for the night, and they should come back tomorrow to continue the discussion.
  • That night, Ethiul is flooded with two visions, one from his original backstory in the city where the rift of inferno opened, and the second is a vision of Voroth declaring a wish to a biblically accurate angel.
  • Then everyone (except Morgan) appears in the liminal dreamscape again. The voice asks Voroth "Did you see that?" but Voroth doesn't get the vision.
  • Addressing everyone the voice says "If Voroth didn't get the vision, that's okay. I know now that Ethiul and Voroth's goals are aligned: You must return to Melody at once."

Books from Jobidrian

###### Celestial Weavings: Chronicles of the Star Druids

By Allan Timberborne, Professor at Coastgate University School of Anthropology

In the sacred annals of the Star Druids, there exists a celestial tapestry woven with threads of cosmic energy. Among its most revered artifacts is the Robe of Constellations, a garment that transcends the boundaries between the mortal realm and the astral expanse. One who seeks the robe simply won't find it; instead it seeks those with a profound connection to the realms. To don this robe is to become a steward of the celestial balance, chosen by the very stars that adorn its dark fabric.

It's not a quest of physical pursuit but a journey of self-discovery and alignment with the celestial forces. Only those who have been touched by the Upper Planes will the robe reveal itself to. To seek it is to embark on a journey of the soul, guided by the very stars that illuminate the night sky. May those who aspire to don this robe find their true celestial calling and become the stewards of the cosmic balance.

###### Cosmic Harmonies: A Star Druid's Guide to the Upper Planes

As transcribed by Aeliana Moonwhisper, Cosmic Vangaurd of the Starlight Grove

In the vast expanse of the multiverse, the Upper Planes stand as beacons of cosmic purpose, embodying the very essence of alignment and divine influence. Scholars and seekers alike delve into the annals of these celestial realms, unraveling the mysteries that shape the very fabric of existence.

Celestia, the celestial bastion, mirrors the ideals we, as Star Druids, hold dear. A canvas of cosmic energy, resembling the vastness of the night sky, it hosts the celestial descendants of radiance and righteousness. Here, selflessness, charity, and the alleviation of suffering reign supreme. True celestial beings, akin to [biblically accurate] angels, call Celestia home. As a Druid of the Stars, one may find solace and guidance in the benevolent light of Celestia, where wishes are granted to those deemed worthy of spreading righteousness across the planes.

Contrasting the celestial brilliance is the fiery Abyss of Inferno, a realm ruled by demons and devoted to the pursuit of suffering. Forsaken souls endure eternal torment in this nightmarish hell-scape. Demons, driven by a malevolent purpose, seek the destruction of the material world. As we traverse the realms, beware the chaotic energies of Inferno, for it embodies the very essence of evil, craving the maximization of suffering upon the material plane.

Mechanus, the plane of order and structure, stands as an intricate tapestry woven with rules, laws, and process. Here, denizens prioritize strict organization, understanding that without structure, they are nothing. Mechanus manifests itself as lawful, embracing principles of logic, order, and methodical process. As Star Druids, we can glean insights into the balance of nature by observing the structured harmony within the Loom of Order.

In stark contrast to the structured order of Mechanus lies Limbo, a swirling vortex of chaos. Here, elements collide in a never-ending dance of unpredictability. Rocks, trees, and entire landscapes intermingle amidst strong winds and pockets of ever-changing matter. As a manifestation of chaos, Limbo celebrates disorder, randomness, and entropy. Star Druids traversing this realm may find themselves challenged by the unbridled energies that embody the chaotic echoes of existence.

In our cosmic journey, let us recognize the significance of these Upper Planes – celestial realms that shape the very fabric of our reality. May the stars guide us as we navigate these diverse dimensions, embracing the cosmic harmonies that connect us to the vastness of the multiverse.

sessions.title: Session 43 - A Portal to Mechanus
sessions.content_html:
• The party met up with Jobidrian again the next day to ask him for teleportation services. He also informed Fen that he would introduce her to a blacksmith that can combine her Staff of Healing and Moon Sickle.
  • Using the Moon Sickle, Jobidrian is able to use it as a reference to teleport the party back to Melody's island on target.
  • Once everyone reunites with Melody, they tell her about what they found in the Two Piece, and give her the engagement ring back.
  • Then, she tells Morgan a bit more about the Sonnet Swashbucklers. She says that Morgan was made the scapegoat for his sister's death to remove him from the inheritance. But, Songbeard chose him anyway which caused Melody to have to hide; she can't say why.
  • She also reveals that she has a gear piece that is almost identical to the Gear that was in the two piece, but she has no idea why.
  • She learns more about the visions from Ethiul, and the voice's insistence that Melody is the key, so she placed her gear inside the other gear.
  • This causes a rift to open in Melody's hut that pulls everyone inside, transporting them to Mechanus.

sessions.title: Session 44 - The Realm of Order
sessions.content_html:
• A bunch of frantic little monodrones begin running around speaking an unknown language (Modron).
  • The monodrones begin following some sort of threat protocol which keeps escalating.
  • Voroth and Tassarion are able to understand the language they are speaking, but cant speak it.
  • Eventually, a tier 4 drone tells them they are not permitted to speak to them directly, but that they must have the proper identification, permits, and clearances to travel to Mechanus.
  • Eventaully this escalates to a tier 5 construct which instigates that all undocumented trespassers into Mechanus must be removed, regardless of whether or not it is intentional.
  • Voroth rips a fireball which immediately evaporates dozens of monodrones. The party eliminates the threat, and from the ashes, Voroth determines that the eye of the tier 5 construct contains runes that indicate safe passage.

sessions.title: Session 45 - Welcome to Automata
sessions.content_html:
• The party, not really knowing where to go, continues onwards towards the center of the gear
  • They come across a moving sign with directions pointing to different places: the mines, the foundries, The Wastes, Automata 25 teeth in length, and Regulus 75 teeth.
  • After several hours of travel, they must perform an investigation check to try and determine how much time has passed. They will need to rest on pass.
  • Once they find the sign and try making a plan, the Pseudo Dragon comes back.
  • Gives a small chip that can "activate" the orb. "This will clear the charges against you for trespassing, with it you have a clean slate, and can head to the nearest town"
  • "Everything you have done, all of you, has been preparing you for the moment you meet. The Master is most interested in meeting you (to Voroth). That's why I have been with you all this time; there is a vast ocean of knowledge that must be shared, and questions to be answer."
  • Ethiul's goals are aligned because you both Ethiul and Voroth needed to travel to Mechanus to complete their personal quests.
  • "Heed my instructions: in the nearest town, Automata, there is a gate. You can use this to meet the master, and leave to the material plane."
  • Ad lib my time has come meme
  • The party then travels in the direction of Automata. There is a huge line they have to wait in, but Tassarion cleverly uses illusion magic to trick the others waiting in line into breaking formation, which sends them to the back of the line allowing them to advance.
  • In line, they meet a human named Spike also trying to get to Automata. Together they are able to advance near the front of the line quickly and only have to wait a couple of hours.
  • They make it to Automata, and try asking who "The Master" is, but with a name that vague, the constructs instead take them to the Leader of the Temple of Aevum.
  • Their leader tells them about the application process to leave Mechanus taking between 18-24 months, but suggests that perhaps their entrance into Mechanus wasn't an "Accident".
  • She tells them that they can learn more about the application and the gate's connection to the planes by asking at the library and tells them to come back when they learn more.

sessions.title: Session 46 - Temple of Aevum
sessions.content_html:
• NPCs often use this phrase:
    • "May the Cogs turn ever in your favor"
  • Town - POIs:
    • Central Gate: at the center of the town. A permit is required to travel through the gate with a wait time of 102 "Turns" which translates to 3 "Material Years".
    • Cog Shaped Resting House: has supplies and a place to rest.
      • Riff: One of the local humanoids who searches the wastes for scrap to sell. Has info that many of the stronger constructs out there require a special "Adamantine Weapon" to be able to pierce their natural armour. He can spare an Adamantine Shortsword (200 GP), adamantine daggers (150 GP), and an Adamantine Rapier (400 GP).
    • Automata Library: Has info about the big gate. The gate connects the planes and can be used to access more than the material planes, including demiplanes and pocket dimensions. Different items can be used to unlock or activate the gate to transport to different places. The material plane is the most standard, but other items can be used to travel elsewhere:
      • Material Plane: Planar Metal
      • Feywilds: Planar Alloy
      • Shadowfell: Planar Ore
      • Spectral Hourglass: Personal temporal demiplane when combined with an artifact from that plane.
      • Catalytic Container: Personal Spacial demiplane.
      • Negative Cog: Astral Plane
      • WARNING: activating the gate without a key is extremely dangerous. Doing this could implode the gate and cause a swarm of chaos destroying everything in the area. (Creates a vortex into Limbo).
    • Temple of Aevum: has monks the order of Aevum. Lord Kairos is their leader. They say their job is to preserve important artifacts from the wastes as not to sever connections to the countless demiplanes in existence. They travel to check if each of the demiplanes still exist, or if they have been closed. They also check if they are inhabited or not. They are currently searching for a spectral hourglass in the wastes. (They can point to where it is.) The wastes are small pockets of disorder used to discard and cleanse the rest of the plane of chaos. They warn that many artifacts are guarded by their maker's constructs if eons past.
  • The Party went to the library to find info on the master and the portals that brought us to Mechanus.
  • They learned that there are keys that can take us to personal pocket dimensions and we can open them by binding the key with an object related to the person.
  • They went back to a tavern to rest before looking for monk's that might be able to help us find the master.
  • They learned that they need either a spectral hourglass or a catalytic container, and there's one in the wastes, in a dangerous ruin; the last squad of monks that went out did not return.
  • Kairos warns that it will be very dangerous. Her parting words are "Cogs be with you".

sessions.title: Session 47 - The Wastes Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• The party traveled into the wastes following the bearing given to them by lord Kairos
  • They met some dwarven scrappers in the wastes that gave them some advise and warnings.

sessions.title: Session 48 - The Wastes Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• The party traverses into the dungeon down a long hall (after taking like 10 minutes to go down some stairs).
  • In this hall, there is a pressure plate (DC 14) that, when triggered drops a massive plate (DC 16) 4d6 damage. They are able to avoid and disarm the trap.

  • Morgan thankfully heard this one as a kid, and they are able to solve the puzzle.
  • This reveals a room to a study or laboratory. After some arcana checks, they discover that Ethiul's tattoo is somehow connected to a rune representing balance. There is also a spell scroll that opens the alternate door which leads into a steam and cog filled hallway of traps.
  • Voroth and Fen are able to use some spells to disarm the traps, and advance towards the end of this room.
  • Then, there's a quite tense argument between Morgan and Melody that leads to him storming off with the rest of the party, leaving Melody behind.
  • They advance to the final clockwork platform where they are met with a clockwork dragon construct as the guardian of the dungeon.

sessions.title: Session 49 - The Wastes Part 3
sessions.content_html:

    • Spectral Hourglass
    • Clockwork Amulet

    • Wild Magic Coin

I will write my own fate. I will get my revenge on those who have wronged me, and slaughter those who are responsible for their (Maris and Songbeard's) death. I am done waiting, and I will take what is rightfully mine.

  • LEVEL UP (10)

sessions.title: Session 50 - The Master in Mechanus Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• The party returns from the ruins to the temple. They ask Lord Kairos if there is anything she can do to help expedite the application process. She says to check back with them after they rest at the tavern.
  • The party goes to the Gear Shaped Resting House and purchases rooms for the night
  • The next morning, Melody invites everyone to join her for breakfast. Morgan blows her off which makes her sad so she asks Fen for some advice.
  • She asks her how she can prove to Morgan that she loves her and that everything she's done, she's done for him. Fen simply says that she can't just say it but also has to show it.
  • She asks Fen if she thinks the Master's Temporal Demiplane exists outside of time, and that if so, she'll tell Morgan then.
  • The party heads back to the temple. Lord Kairos says that she thinks the party can bypass the line by filling out an application and having the temple sponsor them. Since they have a tier 3 clearance orb, they can use that to get their application approved instantly and bypass the line.
  • They all go to the gate office together, submit an application, wait a bit longer, and then are permitted to enter the Master's Temporal Demiplane.
  • They arrive at his space, he is wearing hooded robes; the party are all magically silenced. He then pulls his hood off and reveals that he's also Voroth.

sessions.title: Session 51 - The Master in Mechanus Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• Upon entering the Master's temporal domain everyone seems to be magically silenced as a hooded silhouette appears in the distance.
  • He also says he's met everyone through hundreds of lifetimes and says something about each of them. "Even through thousands of timelines, you're still the same people."
    • "Tassarion: The Hanged Man. So many times I've seen you throw your life away at the opportunity of power, redemption, or revenge; you're so near sighted it hurts. Would you turn on your friends if it meant you got what you're looking for?"
    • "Fen: The Charriot. For someone so unrestrained by your grove I've never met someone so shackled. So many Fens have sought freedom only to remain bound to the destinies of others."
    • "Ethiul: The Fool. You have never amounted to anything; caught up in the short term. Many versions of you have started the trials, but I have known none that have become Cosmic Vangaurds... It's a shame your sister never came to know you in this life. She seems to be the only thing that kept you outside of your own little world."
    • "Voroth: The World. You have given up everything in the pursuit of knowledge, and in the pursuit of me. In a lot of ways, you and I are the same." reveals he's Transcendent Voroth.
  • "I say these things not because they are who you are, but who the thousands of versions of you I've known across the ethos were. Will you be different?"
  • The silence spell is dropped and he says: "I'm sure all of you have a lot of questions. Now that you are in my temporal demiplane, we can communicate unrestricted."

Transcendent Voroth Exposition

  • Since he is the one that uttered the wish spell, he was pulled from the timeline before it was erased from existence. Let's call the original timeline "The Transcendent Timeline"
  • He existed stuck in a liminal space for what felt like multiple lifetimes, forced to watch through the eyes of thousands of Voroths and their lives in their alternate timelines.
  • He cultivated the knowledge, wisdom, and experience of thousands of Voroths over time, experiencing each of their lifetimes in full, one after the other.
  • Eventually, one Voroth, which we'll call Voroth Prime, obtained the very same skull key that Songbeard gave Transcendent Voroth. This caused Transcendent Voroth to be thrust from his liminal prison into "Voroth's Dimension": A sub-dimention of Mecanus, the outer plane of order.
  • As of now, there have been 4 timelines where a Voroth has obtained Songbeard's skull key:
    • Voroth Prime (A)
    • Voroth the Late (D)
    • Voroth Sythstorm (Evoker Wizard, Member of the Groove Crusaders. Killed songbeard to get the key)
    • Voroth (PC Voroth)
  • In Voroth's Temporal Demiplane, he claims to be the keeper of timelines responsible for maintaining the order and balance of time in the multiverse. THIS IS A LIE.
  • In reality, Voroth's Dimension is a prison realm he is held in, because the wish granted by Nila Aashni distrupted the balance of the multiverse's timelines. Voroth essentially was the scapegoat for requesting the wish and was punished for it.
  • Voroth Prime refused and escaped.
  • Voroth the Late accepted and was killed because he wasn't strong enough for the transition ritual.
  • Voroth Synthstorm is another Voroth that is also interested. He is from a timeline where the party are the members in a band called the "Groove Crusaders" and this dimension is perpetually the 1980s.
  • He will try to convince Voroth he needs a successor, and wants PC Voroth to be that successor.
  • Only one alternate Voroth with the key can exist in order to perform the ritual.
  • "Are you willing to fight to be the true successor?"
  • He casts a spell which transports everyone to a temporal arena.
  • Here, Voroth Synthstorm is introduced.

Voroth Battles

  • Voroth Synthstorm Fight

    • Ethiul Starvoice
    • Fen'Herel Moonbass
    • Tassarion the Shredder

  • Voroth fight part 1 he fights with 3 arcane clockwork guardians
  • Voroth fight part 2, domain expansion: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VpFMwXjKmE0
  • In one final attack, Transcendent Voroth unleashes a final attack and kills Voroth.
  • Morgan takes him down, while Fen uses a revivify scroll to revive Voroth.
  • Voroth Paralyzes him with hold person, and they all simultaneously land the final blow.
  • PC Voroth absorbs his intellect when Transcendent Voroth's Soul is erased This gives him a permenant +5 to int.
