sessions.title: Session 52 - Master in Mechanus Part 3
sessions.content_html:
• Are you transcendent because you're Voroth, or are you Voroth because you transcended?

Melody Reveal

  • Morgan before we leave, I want you to know that I can tell you everything, but you need to promise me, that you're ready to hear it.
  • I want to tell you what happened on the day your sister died.
  • Many years before it happened, your father told her that he planned on giving the two piece to you and not her. You were a prodigy, and she was not a capable pirate; not in the slightest (and a woman)
  • Ever since then, she changed.
  • She became so focused and bent on getting his approval that it is all she would ever focus on; but your father never really had a knack for the ways of Magic...
  • Eventually, it must have been that enough is enough... I found letters on her desk for assassins. But the horrible thing was, the goal was not to kill your father, no, the goal was to kill you, Morgan.
  • She wanted the treasure for herself and would stop at nothing to get it.
  • Seeing her fall down this path, darker and darker, I had to intervene.
  • I confronted her, and together we came to an agreement...
  • I along with the assassins would help stage attack on Songbeard and use it to fake her death, and frame you as a scapegoat.
    • Morgan, your sister is alive.
  • She would use this opportunity in isolation to cultivate her powers, and get stronger
  • With the only heir being a banished bastard, she would come back once she felt she was strong enough and present herself to Songbeard as a magical miracle
  • But she severely miscalculated.
  • One day she returned, Songbeard wanted nothing to do with her
  • He must've felt betrayed, and ironically this probably only strengthened his resolve to give the treasure to you
  • I was in town fetching supplies when it happened, she planned around us being together and me being able to defend him...
  • Once I heard the news, I knew I had to flee. I knew right away there would be a target on my back, and I needed to do everything I could to protect the compass to the Two Piece.

What Happens Next

  • Return Home, Melody Dies
  • Return to Raeneros City (or wherever), live out of the ship in port and spend several weeks in down time:

Down Time Activities

  • Morgan converts the sword of life stealing to a rapier, and uses the metal to get studded leather armor (+1)
  • He reads his books and learns he won't break his oath
  • Fen gets her moon sickle and staff of healing combined into one epic superweapon called the Sythe of Life
  • Voroth sells his Mechanus metal, gets tattoos, and buys a Wand of the War Mage (+1) from Jobidrian's friend Rakbara
  • Ethiul travels to the elders to ask them about the robe of stars.

sessions.title: Session 53 - Into the Ice Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• This story takes place about 10 years before the events of the main story, and the events of this story are unrelated to all other main player characters.
  • Ulrich and Selene meet each other on the boat that's heading to whispering pines.
  • They arrive at Whispering Pines, a small town at the base of Frostspire Peak, surrounded in Large, towering pine trees.
  • Ulrich and Selene go to the Eagles Roost Tavern and meet the tavern keep named Eldra who posted the job. Here, they also met two others who accepted the job: Ulgrim Glonkin and A'dam Le'vene.
  • Eldra tells the party of Soren, the melted glacier, and how the task is to save him.
  • Shortly afterwards the party meets Calen, Soren's younger brother who is an aspiring cleric with no battle experience.
  • He agrees to help since he knows the mountain pretty well.
  • The party progresses up the mountain, and talk with Calen more to get to know more about him and whispering pines.
  • The party gets ambushed by some Gnoll's and a young Shoosuva outside of the entrance to a cave.
  • During the battle, A'dam gets wounded greatly, but is healed by Ulrich.
  • At that same time, a Gith monk named Bi'ch'az falls from the sky and joins the fight.
  • Ulgrim dealt the final blow to the Shoosuva ending the battle.

sessions.title: Session 54 - Into the Ice Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• The decided to rest in the cave and restore strength before advancing deeper
  • There are tracks leading deeper into the cave, so the party decided they were on the right track and to venture deeper.
  • Deeper in the cave, the party found a notebook around some blood stains in the snow that read:
"Show your faith, turn, enter darkness, and pray to the light."
  • Eventually the party arrived at a large cavernous room with a deep gorge.
  • After some creative attempts to get across and some ominous advancing statues, they figured out that by extinguishing all light sources, that a spectral bridge would eventually reveals itself.
  • Finally, the party arrived at a temple that was seemingly hidden all the way at the base of the mountain.
  • In this temple, it was revealed that the lady that hired the party, Eldra, was actually an undead "Necro-vore" the entire time. Her plot was to open a rift to "Davy Jones' Locker" from within the temple to consume the souls that pour out for more and more power
  • The party erupted into a big battle against her and her undead minions.
  • They were successful in defeating her, but not in rescuing Calen's Brother Soren, who remains trapped in a necklace pendant.
  • After returning back to Whispering Pines, A'dam decided to move on, continuing to search for new and exotic foods throughout the realms, and Bi'ch'az returned to the Astral Plane.
  • Selene, Ulrich, and Ulgrim remained in whispering pines to help rebuild the town and free Soren from the necklace.

sessions.title: Session 55 - The Stolen Child Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• This story takes place about 30 years before the events of the main story and represent the events that take place as a part of Tassarion's backstory. The target of the attack was Tassarion's wife and daughter.
  • Tavern start, the party is brought together by hooded humanoid; he hired everyone to capture a target alive.
  • The target is a very young girl in a small town to the east called Sirion.
  • This party of kidnappers is comprised of:
    • Ace Maverick, gunslinger extraordinaire.
    • Erenhardt, a human barbarian.
    • Isadora, a tiny halfling bard.
    • Brother Harold Isaac Thaddius Leopold Esquire Reginald II.
    • Luc'a'pizza, a dragonborn paladin.
  • On their way to the town, the party encountered a security checkpoint and were able to convince the guards to let them pass to the town.
  • Upon arrival at the town, the party began to search for the target. There weren't that many houses to check, but they didn't want to come off as suspicious.
  • Eventually, they were able to identify a house to the south as the one that likely contains the target, and proceeded to hatch an elaborate plan to host a concert for the town, since Isadora is an accomplished musician.
  • The party proceeded to spread the word and build anticipation for the concert.

sessions.title: Session 56 - The Stolen Child Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• After building the stage and setting appropriate traps, the concert began.
  • Isadora was able to call up the target, a very young aged elven girl being carried by her mother.
  • They spring the trap, causing a massive eruption of magic in the crowd and killing many civilians.
  • Erenhardt is able to secure the target and begins to flee the scene.
  • The mother resisted but was killed as her daughter was pried from her desperate hands.
  • A huge battle proceeded to ensue, as the party attempted to escape from the village.
  • In the turmoil, Isadora was able to feign ignorance of the attack and was able to escape quietly.
  • Back at the original tavern, the party met back up with the patron, received their payment, gave them the target, and all went on their separate ways.

sessions.title: Session 57 - Ethiul's Call Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• Ethiul leaves Raeneros City to return to the grove alone.
  • When he confronts the Elders with the Robe they say:
    • “The Robe of Constellations has presented itself to you. Please don it, and look inward” Ethiul will feel a surge of magic; DC 15 Wisdom Save
  • He feels surge of determination, and feels the touch of his ancestors.
  • “Please tell us about your parents in your own words.”
    • Ethiul remarks how he was born an only child and that his parents were not very involved in upbringing
  • “Your parents were a strong foundation in your upbringing, doing what they could to mold you into who you are today, but they could not be intimately involved in your upbringing like some of the others in the grove, for they had sworn secrecy.”
  • “Please tell us about what you know of your sister.” Ethiul won’t know.
  • “Her name is Seraphina; you have only met her once, about 20 years ago; too young for you to remember.”
  • She was visiting the Grove one last time before departing for the Astral Plane to serve on the “Council of Cassiopeia” under the Starmother directly
  • Only the most powerful and accomplished Cosmic Vanguards have the opportunity for such an esteemed position under the Starmother; however from this point, the grove and Ethiul’s parents had to conceal her identity.
  • They can tell him now because he is undergoing the trials now.
  • “As you can see, your robe is incomplete, but it will become more complete and brilliant as you continue down this path. Now go. You must rest. The trials will not be merciful.”
  • "Remember that the wise person knows that life's challenges are not obstacles, but opportunities for growth, for it is through adversity that we find our true strength and wisdom."
  • Ethiul goes to sleep, and wakes up in the middle of the night to a forest fire ravaging through the grove (From this point forward, the trial will be in an unrevealed dream space. But more and more weird stuff will happen over time)

Trial of Courage

  • Combat: An ambush of goblins. A wave of fear, DC 20 wisdom save. Each round this will reduce by 5 until it's zero.
  • Introduce ancestors in initiative and they can defeat the enemies and escape the fire.
  • Ancestors can say their name, but can't yet reveal that they are ancestors
  • The Ancestors
    • Thalor "Taurus"
    • Daren "Draco"
    • Escorpio "Scorpio"
    • Leo "Leo"
  • Another cloaked figure tells them to come with them, they need to escape or the forest will burn down.

Trial of Wisdom

  • They run off into the woods. The party gives chase but that person disappears (because they are an illusion)
  • Party is lost in the woods, and needs to camp.
  • Try to orient with perception.
  • Notice this area of the forest is very strange... Spot creatures observing them in the distance with successful perception
  • Satyr appears and tells them a riddle:
    • "I am always hungry, I must always be fed. The finger I touch, will soon turn red. I kill kings and nobles alike, and even the strongest warriors cannot escape my bite. What am I?"
    • IF RIGHT: He tells them to follow him out of the forest. (DC 25 insight) to realize he will lead them to a trap)
    • IF WRONG: Burst of flames: a level 5 fireball
  • Continue walking, passive perception Ethiul notices they've seen the same tree multiple times
  • If they figure out that the terrain is an illusion, it will dissipate and they will find themselves in the middle of a village outside of a tavern.

Trial of Temperance

  • In the tavern is the annual dragonborn sex convention
  • Multiple dragonbornes approach Ethiul intrigued by the presence of an outsider. DC 15 wisdom save or be charmed.
  • If he resists this the trial will end and he will be approached by an elven woman in mysterious cloaks.

Trial of Justice

  • She asks Ethiul if he is ready. She says he needs to search within himself and restore balance to the chaos within.
  • He realizes the room he's standing in is now empty, and all of a sudden, just him and the woman are in
  • If he says yes he is appears in a chaos realm for the final battle

sessions.title: Session 58 - Ethiul's Call Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• 4 Elementals
  • Ethiul Clone +30 health
  • Ethiul Wakes up
  • The elders ask Ethiul what they though of his sister (the cloaked figure)
  • They then give Ethiul a scroll that's meant to be delivered to Fen
  • EVERYONE LEVEL UP (11)

sessions.title: Session 59 - Fen's Call Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• Gets a letter returned by Ethiul from the grove. Apparently she missed too many days of school and needs to get an alternate education.
Greetings,

It has come to our attention that you have not yet fulfilled the necessary requirements to complete your studies within our revered grove. Your mastery over the natural arts, while promising, remains incomplete, with several critical elements of the druidic path left untouched. Thus, we decree that you are to continue your training at the Frostspire College of Magic in Whispering Pines. It is there that you will be tested in both skill and spirit. You will be tasked with completing the following areas of study:
- Flora & Fauna Symbiosis
- Elemental Convergence
- Evocation, and Conguration Theory
- Foreign Language

Make haste, Fen'Harel, for the balance of nature waits for none.

In the name of the Grove
Archdruid Realta Mané
  • She is being sent to the Frostspire College of Magic to complete her certifications
  • Party travels to whispering pines. On the way, Tassarion plays Movement 3: Rhapsody of Haste continuously to make the trip faster.
  • At one point they are stopped by a band of pirates working for the Sonnet Swashbucklers looking for a license to pass into those waters.
  • Tassarion just tells them that the party are members of the Sonnet Swashbucklers, and is so convincing, that they apologize, pack up, and leave.
  • After the party arrives at whispering pines, they all travel to the Gatekeeper's inn where they meet Ulrich Thunder, Ulgrim Glonkin, and Selene Starweaver. They are the co-founders of the Frostpire College of Magic and Selene is the dean and main founder.
  • Ulrich reveals to Morgan the curse of his family and his quest for vengeance on Sarsynanth, the ice queen who placed the curse on his family.

sessions.title: Session 60 - Fen's Call Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• The party meets Ulrich in the tavern the next morning to head to the college for the magic demonstration
  • During the demo, Voroth assesses each of the students. He realizes that while some students have good potential, none of the students are even close to as strong as Ethiul or even Fen, and therefore none of the students are strong enough to be a suitable apprentice to him.
  • Fen does her demo last, and shocks the students and Selene with magic power that is nearly on par with Selene herself.
  • The Students want Selene to do a demonstration herself because they want her to prove that she is stronger than all the students.
  • She casts a massive fireball (at the 6th level) directly at her students. After a massive explosion, the flames dissipate revealing that all the students in the blast are completely unscathed.
  • This demonstration shows Voroth that Selene so much stronger than then rest, and he asks her to become his apprentice.
  • Selene refuses, saying she has a school to run and she can't just uproot her life and abandon everything; she's built a new life for herself that's really successful and doesn't want to give that up.
  • Voroth continues to insist, and eventually this prompts Selene into asking him to demonstrate his magic.
  • Voroth Casts a weakened version of his Domain Expansion that he learned from Transcendent Voroth - a small black orb appears and dissipates, but its magical presence is enough to convince both Selene and Ulrich that Voroth is the real deal.
  • Ulrich tells Selene that the party is powerful enough to help them with an expedition, and Selene tells Voroth and the party that she will consider being his apprentice IF they help them with their next expedition and she herself can find a suitable successor for the school.
  • Back at the tavern, Calen arrives to share a meal with the party as Ulrich explains the research they've been doing.
  • The Frostspire Glaciers are permiated by an unknown, inherently chaotic magic source. They know that Sarsynanth the Ice Queen resides near the source, and that this magic enhances her to be far more powerful than an ordinary dragon. Together, they can venture deeper into the glacier to potentially learn more about the source of the chaotic magic, or to locate Sarsynanth's lair.

sessions.title: Session 61 - Trek into the Glaciers Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• Selene will invite the party to her office at the college to showcase some magic items. They are willing to negotiate to give more than what the stated allowance is.
  • Ulrich will make sure there is nothing else they need to prepare for, and everyone will leave for the glaciers the following morning. In the morning there's a bright and twinkling light snowfall. He mentions that both him and Selene have an ice shard with ice from the glaciers which they are following the energy of.
  • As they continue upwards for about 2 hours, the snowfall begins to get heavier and the wind begins to pick up. Anyone who doesn't have cold resistance must make a DC 14 Con save. Failure results in 2d6 cold damage.
  • Ulrich asks Tassarion about his life/deal since he's been quiet the last several days. There is more conversational role play opportunities here.
  • Ulrich announces that they are about to enter more dangerous territory, and that if the weather doesn't let up, they might have to stop early, or even turn back. Asks the party what they want to do
  • Ethiul passively spots a silhouette at the top of the section of mountain they are climbing and by the time he warns everyone the creature lets off a loud shriek and an avalanche begins. If hit by the snow, the creature is knocked prone and must make a DC 15 strength save or take 2d10 bludgeoning damage (half as much on a pass) and 1d6 cold damage. Creatures swept away dissappear from the map and are blinded and restrained. DC 15 athletics to dig free on each turn. 3 failures results in getting "stuck" and not being able to attempt again.
  • During the encounter, Fen notices that many of the others were swept away by the avalanche, and she flies down to help them.
  • Once this encounter ends, the party is separated with Ulrich, Ulgrim, Fen, Calen, and Soren too far from earshot. Selene receives a message from Ulrich through sending stones:
We're okay. Fen helped us. Storm worsening with low visibility. Continue upwards to flatter ground about one hour and seek Shelter. More info tomorrow morning.

Selene & Ulgrim Items:

Items (Each Pick 1)

  • Periapt of Wound Closure
  • Cloak of Cold Resistance x3
  • Studded Leather Armor of Cold Resistance
  • Dragon Slayer Rapier
  • Dragon Slayer Longsword
  • Vibraslap of Relocation
  • Life Force Goggles

Potions (Each pick 2)

  • Potion of Flying
  • Potion of Cold Resistance
  • Potion of Invisibility
  • Splash Potion of Greater Healing
  • Potion of Superior Healing

Scrolls (Pick 3 Total)

  • Mass Cure Wounds
  • Beacon of Hope
  • Passwall
  • Galder's Tower
  • Hallucinitory Terrain

sessions.title: Session 62 - Trek into the Glaciers Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• With the weather worsening and Voroth without protection from the elements, Selene created a tiny hut shelter and everyone takes a long rest until the morning
  • The next morning, the weather looks much nicer and Selene receives a message from Ulrich and the others saying that the mission is still on due to the improved conditions, and they they should meet at the Rendezvous point.
  • Voroth, without cold resistance, must make a DC 16 Con Save. Failure results in 2d6 cold damage and level 1 exhaustion. He is able to resist the cold, and Tassarion gives him a torch to keep warm as they continue into the glaciers.
  • The party next needs to navigate across a frozen lake. With Morgan's light-footedness and Ethiul's perception, they are able to plot a path to avoid breaking the ice and falling through the lake.
  • While everyone is attempting to cross, two frost salamanders burst through the ice.
    • 2 Frost Salamanders
    • 3 Ice Mephits on high ground casting ice knife
    • 1 new ice mephit emerges from the lake at initiative 0 and get's put in the count.
  • During this fight Voroth goes down Voroth saw transcendent Voroth visit him in his mind, calling out his hubris and overconfidence, almost dying in battle as a result.
  • He is guarded and rescued by Selene and Morgan. After the encounter Morgan seems upset at Voroth; everyone finishes crossing the lake and seek shelter in a cave - the same cave the others stayed in the night prior.
  • Selene and Voroth send a message back to the others saying they need to stop and rest, and that they will meet a day later than expected.

sessions.title: Session 63 - Mountaintop Battle Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• Begin with a Nightmare Voroth is having:
You think you're different than the others, don't you? You’re just like me. Every choice you make is one we’ve already made. Even if you succeed, it won’t matter. It never does. Remember this: Overconfidence is a slow and insydious killer.
  • He jolts awake in a cold sweat, everyone else is already awake and notices this.
  • Ulrich sends Selene another message saying the weather is getting worse again today, but they are at the meeting point and will wait for them. They urge the party to hurry though as conditions seem to be worsening.
  • A fizzure opens up underneath the party and Voroth feather falls everyone down. After climbing out, they continued to the meeting point.
  • When meeting up the full party creates a plan to take on the dragon. Afterwards, Voroth casts contact other plane to look within himself
  • In his mind he meets Voroth Prime, the original Voroth who was the first person to ever find the skull key and learns that he can tap into other Voroth's wisdom and experience, not just Transcendent Voroth.
  • Through the worsening storm, everyone sees a vortex on top of mountain peak in the distance.
  • Summit the mountain, Voroth will have to make another check due to the conditions being so bad; he passes.
Yet another of the "cursed" bloodline, desperate to fulfill their destiny. Does it ever occur to you that your endless pursuit is not justice, but obsession? Your ancestors came to me seeking power—power they did not deserve, and one that I alone safegaurd. I refused, and in their arrogance they dared to defy me. It is their failure that became your curse, and now you carry their sins like a torch, blindly wielding it as rightous vengeance.
  • Party controls both oneshot and main characters (Mini controls Ulrich, Soup controls Soren)
  • Fight Phase 1:
    • 4 Guard Drakes
    • Ancient White Dragon
  • MOONBEAM DAMAGE ALREADY ACCOUNTED FOR

sessions.title: Session 64 - Mountaintop Battle Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• Continue Battle
  • Last words:
You are no hero; your cause is meaningless. Strike me down if you must but know that you are not freeing your bloodline; you are dooming it. With my death, the curse will not fade, it will fester; what I guard will be unleashed, and the folly of your ancestors will be realized. untamed, and consume you. Will you truly damn your kin and your friends in your blind thirst for revenge?
  • The Defeated Dragon explodes with frost and lightning causing everyone to fall into the lair
  • Get to the Dragon's Lair
  • Fight Phase 2:
    • Elder Tempest
    • 4 Frost Golems

sessions.title: Session 65- Mountaintop Battle Part 3
sessions.content_html:
• Phase 2 of the fight continues.
  • The Elder Tempest releases a massive wave of energy and magic knocking down Voroth, Fen, Ulgrim, and knocking back Ulrich and Selene.
"Give me control for just a moment. I can end this." - Transcendent Voroth
  • Voroth allows Transcendent Voroth to control him, allowing him to cast DOMAIN EXPANSION
  • Voroth engulfs the downed members of the party into his domain, blessing and fortifying them. He regains consciousness, but needs to maintain concentration on the spell.
  • The party continue to fight, and attempt to retreat into the domain. Morgan, Calen, Ethiul, and Soren barely make it, but Calen is able to massively heal everyone once inside.
  • As the calamity continues slamming into the walls attempting to break in Selene readies a fireball.
  • Once the calamity breaks in it's unleashed, and everyone attacks whittling it down and dealing the final blow.
  • After the party defeats the elder tempest the storm immediately dissipates.
  • Voroth Collapses from exhaustion and is cared for by Fen while the rest of the party investigates the Dragon's Lair for loot and items.
  • Voroth eventually wakes up and staggers his way over to the rest of the party to be lambasted by Morgan, who is concerned that the power he is indulging will eventually corrupt his mind.
  • After this heated discussion calms down, the party use a Teleportation Scroll they found to return to whispering pines while Ethiul and Soren travel back on foot which takes about two days.
  • While traveling down the mountain, Ethiul and Soren share a romantic moment looking at the stars.
  • Back at the Gatekeeper's Inn, the party celebrates and divides their loot. Selene decides she wants to take up Voroth's offer to become his "apprentice", although she's fairly clear that her motivation seems to be about ensuring the knowledge of Domain Expansion is not lost from Voroth's recklessness in dangerous settings.
  • Accordingly, she appoints Fen to take her place as the new dean of the Frostspire College of Magic.
  • Shocked by this, Fen decides to accept since she doesn't feel cut out for the level of danger the party is continuing to incur, and she can complete her educational training for the MoonStar Grove in parallel.
  • Upon learning about this when arriving the next day, Ethiul gets quite upset, feeling like he is going to lose a sister who has always been by his side. He runs off and turns into a pickle.
  • Fen, upon finding him sulking in pickle form, also turns into a pickle so they can be pickles together for a bit.
  • Morgan having just witnessed Ulrich fulfill a major milestone of his oath, becomes upset and slightly resentful over his companions' lack of urgency towards his own goals...
  • LEVEL UP (12)

Items

  • Frostspire Demascus (Ulrich's Great Grandfather Bjorn Thunderbane)
  • Arcane Grimoire +2 (Ulrich's Grandfather Haldor Thundersoul)
  • Staff of Lighting and Thunder (Ulrich's Mother Freya Thundersmite)
  • 4 Diamonds worth ~1000GP each
  • 40 Platinum bars (5 stacked in front of each statue)(40,000 GP)
  • Assortments of 20-30 colored gemstones
  • Various smaller gemstones in the hoard pile
  • White Dragon Egg - Taken by Ethiul and Soren

Consumables

  • Potion of Speed
  • Potion of Superior Healing x2
  • Potion of Frost Giant Strength
  • Scroll of Spiritual Weapon
  • Scroll of Ice Storm
  • Scroll of Revivify
  • Scroll of Teleport

sessions.title: Session 66 - Down Time
sessions.content_html:
• This wasn't a real session, rather an "asynchronous" session where we discussed down time activities.
  • Several weeks pass and the party remains in whispering pines during this time to tie up the loose ends.

Selene, Fen, and Voroth

  • Selene trains and prepares Fen for assuming the role of Dean of the College.
  • Voroth is incapable of casting spells or manipulating the weave for several weeks. This power eventually returns after about 6 weeks.
  • Together with Voroth, they spend most of their time at the College studying, teaching, and preparing to take over Selene's responsibilities.

Ethiul and Soren

- Ethiul and Soren continue to develop their relationship, caring for the Egg and going on hunting excursions together into the mountains.

- One night, when Ethiul and Soren are watching the aroura together, Ethiul has a dream where he is visited by his sister. This time, she is much closer, and the details of her face reveal that she is wearing a blindfold.

"Brother, as the path before you grows clearer your eyes may not perceive it; vision can be a gift, but it is also a veil. The next step in your journey requires you to don the blindfold. It is not merely a cloth to cover your sight but a reminder to look inward. With your eyes closed to the chaos around you, you will learn to perceive the eternal harmony that binds the cosmos.

Remember, Ethiul: the wise do not flinch at darkness, for they know it is from within that shadows fall away, leaving only clarity. You must walk with unwavering trust, guided not by what you see, but by what you know to be true. In this, you will find the strength to endure, the serenity to lead, and the wisdom to ascend."
  • Ethiul Dons the blindfold, to begin this ritual. Ethiul now automatically fails all perception checks that rely on vision, and gains blindsight and truesight at a radius of 10ft.
  • LEVEL UP (13)

Morgan and Tassarion

  • Morgan, impatient with the others' lack of urgency towards his goals, decides to pursue them alone for a bit.

sessions.title: Session 67 - The Marooned Sailor Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• Following the conclusion of the expedition into the glaciers, the party decides to rest in Whispering Pines for some time.
  • Morgan, impatient with the others' focus on other tasks, and the overall lack of urgency towards his goals, decides to pursue them alone during this downtime.
  • Tassarion notices there's something wrong with Morgan and approaches him.
  • Together with Cleff, they decided to team up and spend the remaining down time searching for Maris, or a way to get to her.
  • Cleff informs them that they still have at least 4 weeks of downtime given how long the transition process is taking for Selene and Fen.
  • They decide to split up to prepare for an expedition; tassarion buys two weeks worth of supplies and rations, Morgan writes a letter to the rest of the party and they bring everything to port to set sail.
  • They leave on the Ship of Theseus to head to saltmarsh on Cleff's suggestion as it's the closest settlement that will have plenty of sailors with potential leads.
  • Ask how many days of supplies they want to take with them.
    • 5 GP per day of supplies, of which they get two weeks worth.
  • As they travel south through the sea of syncopation, a thick fog sets in.
  • As they continue traveling, there's a break in the fog and they see a sinking ship
  • The beginning of this encounter will run as normal initiative until about 4 or 5 rounds in when Spirits and ghosts begin emerging from the whirlpool each round.
  • In total 3 sailors got sucked into the wirlpool, but due to Aqua's quick thinking, two of them were able to breath underwater and narrowly avoid a terrible haunted fate.
  • After rescuing the crew, they said the other ship had a cannon that fired ammunition capable of creating the whirlpools; it feels like sinister magic.
  • The whirlpool seemed to pull sailors below sea and release their souls as banshees.
  • Morgan and Tassarion, realizing that two of the people they rescued in particular were extrodinarily stronger than everyone else began to get suspicious.
  • Cleff urged everyone rest until they arrive at Saltmarsh

sessions.title: Session 68 - The Marooned Sailor Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• After a long rest following the whirlpool encounter, the rescued crew, Morgan, Tassarion, and Cleff arrived in Saltmarsh.
  • The crew tried to give Morgan a sack of gold for saving them, but he declines and lets them keep the coin for themselves.
  • At this point the other two crew members introduce themselves. Aqua is a half-merfolk swashbuckler, and Mirikian is a Duegar monk/thief.
  • Mirikian says he was on the ship to protect the crew, and Aqua said she was hitching a ride to search for someone.
  • She reveals that she is looking for someone named "The Marooned Sailor" in the sea of cascades who is said to broker information about factions and people's whereabouts.
  • Morgan, hearing this, offers to let them travel since they are also looking for someone and could also use "The Marooned Sailor's" help. But first, he wants to go into town to a tavern he used to frequent for more information and supplies.
  • The party goes to a tavern called "The Sea Sharppe"; it's dingy and dirty, and no one seems to enjoy their presence, but they grab a table and order food regardless.
  • Morgan recognizes the bard there, a halfing named Anna Log. He approaches there and learns that he shouldn't be here. She tells him that things are very different since the death of his father, and the Sonnet Swashbucklers have regressed into a secretive group. She is sad that they don't bring the same life into taverns like they used to.
  • She leaves Morgan with a warning that many are out for him, and hands him a bottle.
  • The party then is able to de-escalate some hostile language from some of the lackeys in the tavern before being kicked out and told not to come back.
  • Mirikian remembers that Morgan is "The Disgraced Pirate" that everyone had told him about and that he betrayed the Sonnet Swashbucklers and formed a new pirate faction called "Melody's Tempest".
  • He also heard that Tassarion was a member of the Melodic Marauders, but deserted them to join Melody's Tempest as well.
  • The party then purchased supplies for their voyage and decided to head south to the city of Coastgate to sail through Barron's Pass.
  • While sailing southward, Tassarrion finally confided his backstory to Morgan.
    • He revealed that about 30 years ago, his wife was murdered and his daughter was kidnapped by some thugs.
    • After years of trying to get them back, his unanswered prayers led him to forging a pact with a mystical being that promised to help.
    • Using the powers imparted to him by this patron, he has been collecting the pieces to Johann Sea-Bastion Bach's Magnum Concierto, which he needs for a ritual.
    • He also confides in Morgan that his sister Maris is also collecting these works and is a necessary part of this ritual.
    • They agree not to dwell on what this could mean for them in the future.
  • After several days of travel, the party arrives at Coastgate. Wanting to avoid paying any fees, they recall their ship into its bottle and walk around the coast to re-embark in the Sea of Cascades.
  • Morgan checks the bottle he received from Anna. It contains a message that reads:
The Marooned Sailor holds the key,
She is majestic, bold, and bright.
Follow crimson flags to sea,
And find her warm embrace tonight.
  • The party is able to spot a small transport vessel, and they follow it into the fogs of the Sea of Cascades.
  • Eventually, they emerge from the fog to find a gargantuan vessel with the lettering "The Marooned Sailor"; She was not a person, but a ship all along.
  • The party is able to dock and recall their ship and approach the lobby.
  • There, they steal the name "Morgan Stormsail" from the ledger to check in, which they do, paying 100 GP each with a 50 GP discount.
  • Entering into the main room reveals a massive casino.

sessions.title: Session 69 - The Marooned Sailor Part 3
sessions.content_html:
• The party scanned the room to see dozens of tables playing various gambling games.
  • Among Roulette, 3 Dice, Fool's Fortune, and black jack, the party decided to play a round of black jack, winning about 100 GP among all of them across the various games.
  • Morgan then went back to the front desk to inquire about the higher tier packages.
  • Morgan convinced everyone to go for the Admiral's tier which cost each person an additional 800 GP per person but would give them access to both floors two and 3.
  • Then everyone went upstairs to gain more information on who "The Marooned Sailor" could be and where to find them.
  • The second floor contained a brothel with several staff members walking around with patrons in scantily clad clothing.
  • Tassarion ordered a glass of goat's milk from the bar, but the tender needed to go upstairs to the kitchen to get it.
  • Meanwhile Morgan spoke with a wealthy couple that was stopping from upstairs. He learned that "The Marooned Sailor" is an older human with an eyepatch, and that he often plays high stakes with customers in the casino.
  • With this information the party continued upstairs to investigate the top floor.
  • The top floor contained a restaurant and theatre; Cleff convinced the party to eat at the restaurant.
  • After eating at the restaurant, the waitress invited the party to watch the show which would be starting shortly. It was a new musical called "The Tragedy of Gorman the Pirate"
  • To introduce the show, a man matching the description of "The Marooned Sailor" given by the wealthy couple downstairs.
Song 1 – "The Pirate Gorman" (Celebrating Gorman's Rise)

Oh, there was a pirate, young and so bright,  
With a heart full of courage, and eyes full of light.  
He sailed the great oceans, a leader so bold,  
With a crew at his back, and treasures untold!

Gorman, the pirate, so handsome, so grand,  
A captain admired, with a strong, steady hand!  
The sea was his kingdom, his friends were his pride,  
A legend in the making, with the wind as his guide!

Song 2 – "The Tempting Word" (The Turning Point)

Gorman, so noble and true,  
Had a mother with plans far askew.  
With a whisper so sweet,  
She enticed him to cheat,  
And betrayed his own crew to pursue!

Song 3 – "Harmony’s Song" Mother Harmony’s Influence)
 
“Power and gold, my dear son, are the prize,  
The world can be yours if you open your eyes.  
Forget all your friends, let them fall to the side,  
With me by your side, we’ll take all the tide!”

“Call me Harmony, your guide through the night,  
A beacon of cunning, of ambition and might.  
I offer you fortune, and rule over the waves—  
Embrace your dark destiny, and become what you crave!”

“Take what is yours, no mercy, no care,  
Let greed be your master, and forget the despair.  
The sea isn’t loyal, the crew’s just a jest,  
Take the throne, Gorman, and leave them to rest!”

Song 4 – "The Betrayal" (Gorman’s Greed Takes Over)

Gorman, with greed in his heart,  
Turned on his crew, tore them apart.  
His mother’s words stung,  
To the throne, he had sprung,  
But he found in the end, it was all just a start!

Song 5 – "The Weakness Within"** (Gorman’s Downfall)

Once mighty, once proud, now crumbled and torn,  
His hunger for power had left him forlorn.  
With no true allies, no crew to rely,  
His dreams of dominion now drowned in the tide.

For greed eats the soul, and lust feeds the mind,  
Leaving only a man who’s alone, blind, and maligned.  
A king of nothing, a captain of dust,  
Gorman’s fate, a lesson: never betray trust.

Song 6 – "Sister’s Revenge" (Sarah’s Victory)

But Gorman’s sister, with strength of her own,  
Saw through the lies, she’d never been thrown.  
She struck like the waves when the storm’s on the rise,  
And brought down the man who once stood so wise.

Oh, Sarah, the sister, with justice on her side,  
Defeated the brother who had nowhere to hide!  
With heart pure and steady, she cast down his crown,  
And watched as Gorman’s empire tumbled down.
  • Everyone seemed to enjoy the show except for Morgan, who thought the plot was very similar to his own backstory, but a lot less favorable to the character representing his likeness.
  • They then proceeded to head back to the casino floor and go to the high-roller room.
  • Upon entering, everyone felt a shift in presence, Especially Tassarion and to a lesser extend Morgan; this room seemed to have an anti-magic field.
  • The same man was in the room: The Marooned Sailor. He was an older Human with gray hair, an eyepatch, and a large leather hat. He introduced himself as "Ace Maverick" and claimed to have information, but would only exchange it with bets. on a number guessing game.
  • He pulled out a gun, loaded a bullet in the chamber, and spun the cylinder.
  • Aqua went first, and bet her hand. She asked if he knew anything about who her biological father could be, but she guessed the wrong number and had to pull the trigger instead.
  • The gun didn't fire, but it advanced wherever the bullet was to the next chamber.
  • Next, Mirikian bet his hand in exchange for 1000 GP, because there wasn't really any information he was looking for. He guessed the correct number, won the bet.
  • Morgan went next, and he bet his knee and asked a question about Maris' whereabouts as well as for more information on the Sonnet Swashbucklers. He also guessed correctly and learned that the information he has on the Captains isn't up-to-date, and that he doesn't know exactly where she would be, but the captains definitely would know.
  • After a few more rounds of guesses, Morgan asked another question, but this time had to bet Tassarion's arm. He guessed the wrong number, and the gun clicked advancing the chamber again.
  • Morgan, in a miraculous bout of perception, spotted the bullet in the chamber and learned that the next shot in the gun is the one that will discharge the bullet.
  • Morgan was able to make another bet, this time a 50/50 roll, but Ace didn't seem nervous at all about the outcome. Morgan guessed odd, and the number rolled, even, meaning he loses.
  • He pointed the gun to his head and at the last second changed targets shooting Ace in the chest.
  • Silence erupted through the room, and he looked down at his chest, but there were no marks. He smiled and stood up, asking Morgan smugly if he didn't think he'd expect something like this from his clientele; the bullet was a blank!
  • He leaned in to Morgan and asked him if he knew why he loved gambling so much to which Morgan replied "let me guess... it's because the house always wins?" (sarcastic tone)
  • "That's right, Morgan, the house always wins." - ROLL FOR INITIATIVE!

sessions.title: Session 70 - The Marooned Sailor Part 4
sessions.content_html:
• He quickly threw a smoke bomb at the party and used the cover to exit the room.
  • The party chased after him, able to spot him in the crowd.
  • Mirikian dashed forward and tackled him causing the whole bottom floor to erupt in a panic.
  • The guards began rushing to support their leader, but as soon as it had started it was already over.
  • Morgan had him on the ground surrendering and on the brink of death, a vengeful look in his eyes.
  • The party pulled him into a back room for interrogation with a few of the guards while the rest of the staff began evacuating patrons.
  • Morgan told him to answer every single one of their questions. He asked more about the Sonnet Swashbucklers and learned:
    • One of their members frequents his ship and is on the way as they speak.
    • One of the fabled works of Johann Sea-Bastion Bach is getting auctioned at the Crosta City Grand Auction in about a month.
    • The ship with the eldritch cannon likely belongs to captain Quincy Tett, and not Maris herself because she remains in hiding
  • Aqua asked again about her father, and While Ace didn't know much, he did say that there were some members of the Melodic Marauders that were fancy on Merfolk, so that would probably be the best place to continue searching.
  • Tassarion then began asking questions about the ship itself. He learned that The Marooned Sailor is Ace's greatest gamble ever; he used money from an odd job from 30 years ago to fund this venture and it ended up paying off big.
  • Tassarion then asked what the job was. He replied just a random kidnapping job in a small village north of Coastgate. Tassarion continued to probe?
  • "What Village?"
  • "Oh gosh, I cant' remember... Sib? Sibbeon? ... Simbeon?"
  • "Sirion?"
  • "Yeah Sirion! Wait... how did you know that?"
  • Tassarion grabbed him by the throat and choke slammed him into the wall.
  • He realized this man must have been in his village 30 years ago when his wife was murdered and his daughter was taken away. HE is responsible for his turmoil.
  • He continued to interrogate: "Where is she?!" "Who Hired you?!"
  • Ace pleaded for his breath and his life, but he couldn't answer these questions. He just performed the job and got paid.
  • Tassarion, restraining Ace against the wall told him "I'll see you in hell you absolute filth." and cast disintegrate on him, killing him instantly and turning him to a pile of dust.
  • Tassarion began to weep, and from the ashes of Ace's corpse emerged a magic flintlock that Morgan grabbed to hold on to.
  • After the party came to, Morgan commanded the guards and staff to begin loading all the platinum and gold from the vault onto their ship, and that they could take whatever they wanted afterwards.
  • The party prepared for the arrival of Captain Brian Teyy, where they would stage a trap in the lobby
  • The moment arrived, and Brian Teyy showed up with a few other crew. Springing the trap, Morgan emerged from the party's hiding spot and demanded more information, but Brian refused.
  • He accepted defeat upon arrival, and facing the resolve of death he fought against them until the bitter end, nearly taking Aqua down with him. With his last breaths, he declared to Morgan that he'd be back.
  • After the battle, the party fled from The Marooned Sailor, and set a course for Raeneros City.
  • There, Tassarion, Morgan, and Cleff went their separate ways from and sought out a bank to deposit all of the coin they stole while Aqua and Mirikian grouped up to continue looking for her father by finding some of the Melodic Marauders who might be able to lead her in the correct direction.
  • After depositing the funds, Tassarion, Morgan, and Cleff continued northward to Whispering Pines, to meet up with the rest of the main party and tell them of the progress they've made and the things they've learned.

sessions.title: Session 71 - The Grand Auction Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• Over the past several weeks the party has accomplished the following:
    • Selene properly trained and prepared Fen to overtake her as the Dean of the Magic College
    • Voroth meditated and studied on why his connection to the weave is inhibited. He spends about 4 weeks without any magic and in this time, he works with some of the students to develop some new spells while Selene finished training Fen:
      • Acid Bomb
      • Illusory Double
    • Meanwhile, every single night Voroth is haunted by the harrowing presence of Transcendent Voroth in his mind. It IS beginning to drive him mad, and it's becoming a concern
    • Ethiul and Soren continue developing their relationship and caring for the white dragon egg that was found in the Ice Queen's Lair.
  • Some days later, Selene and Voroth wake up to a note from Morgan that reads:
going to town to run errands, might be a couple days or a few weeks dont really know yet. don't go crazy while we're gone. - M & T
  • Voroth and Selene are a bit surprised, but don't think much of it.
  • Some weeks pass with Selene able to help study and restore Voroth's connection to the Weave, and block out Transcendent Voroth's influence.
  • One day, one of the Student researchers, named Elowyn, come's in and tells Ms Selene that they may have a breakthrough with Voroth on their research.
  • In the lab, the students begin a ritual that they have done routinely, but they need her to contribute her high magical abilities. The goal of the ritual is to see if it's possible to enter Voroth's consciousness. If it's possible, then they can casts a high level imprisonment spell on Transcendent Voroth and seal away his influence.
  • She must follow the words and gestures that the students tell her to do the ritual. This expends a 7th level slot from her, and she ends up inside Voroth's Conciousness, greeted by Transcendent Voroth in a liminal space.
  • Voroth can hear everything, but can't interact with either of them.
  • "She's using you y'know? Why? Why do you want to steal from us? You only care about MY magic, you don't care for him at all."
  • "I can kill him y'know. He's MY hostage. You are both just pawns in my grand plan."
  • "You thought I'd let a weakling like him kill me? He WAS my escape from the prison. And his vessel is almost mine."
  • At the end of this encounter Selene must make a DC 15 wisdom saving throw:
    • On a pass she is not frightened. She also gains advantage against being frightened by Voroth forever.
    • On a fail she is frightened and ejected from his head taking 8d10 psychic damage.
  • She is cursed. Every time Voroth casts a 5th level or higher spell she must make a DC 10 + spell level wisdom saving throw or be frightened by Voroth for 1 minute
  • When Selene and Voroth come to, Voroth realizes he has a connection to the weave again and can cast spells.
  • Selene feels like she gained some knowledge from this (and is not able to cast simple domain expansion)
  • The researchers say that the ritual worked, but in order to perform the second part of the spell the party will need two things:
    • A relic statue of Chronos, the construct demigod of Mechanus. They say it must be an original relic forged in Mechanus by the Clockwork Angels. They are extremely rare, but often sought after by ultra wealthy aristocrats that collect artifacts.
    • A mage powerful enough to cast the imprisonment spell to lock away Transcendent Voroth
    • Upon further questioning, one might reveal that the ritual can be cast with an item called a Soulshackle Skull. This item is powerful enough to accomplish both, but might be more dangerous to execute because they won't have as powerful of a mage with them.
  • Selene begrudgingly acknowledges that her family might know someone who can help cast this spell
  • After this incident a few more days pass; Morgan and Tassarion return.
  • They exchange details about the things that have happened to each other while they were separated.
  • Morgan says they need to go to the Crosa City Auction to find more
  • They tell some of what happened and the party makes a plan to go to the grand auction
  • The party sets sail for Raenaros City to withdrawal funds from the banks for the auction, and to get directions to where the auction could be.

sessions.title: Session 72 - The Grand Auction Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• The party traveled to Raenaros City through the Barron's Pass to withdrawal funds from the bank.
  • The party has access to up to 850,000, and Morgan decides to take all of it to the Auction, not knowing how much they would need.
  • The Party then traveled to Bidrian's Biddings to catch up with Jobidrian, ask him where the Crosta City Grand Auction is, and introduce him to Selene.
  • Selene then purchased a Deck of Illusions from Jobidrian
  • The Party then departed to cross the Sea of Cascades on a several weeks journey to Crosta City
  • On their travels, the party encountered two ships that tried to rob them of all their treasure they were travelling with, but they were lame and swiftly defeated
  • Tassarion killed one of the surrendered pirates who was begging for their life.
  • Eventually, the party arrived at Crosta City, docked the Ship of Theseus, and checked into the auction.
  • They needed to front 50,000 GP in coin as collateral to prove they can afford to attend the event, but this comes with getting custom fitted suits and dresses, and they get fancy inn rooms for the duration of the event. The party is assigned participant # 1734
  • They also received a schedule to the event and made an appointment to get fitted in the morning

- Day 2: Art showcase 1 in both halls

sessions.title: Session 73 - The Grand Auction Part 3
sessions.content_html:
• The party had a nice buffet style breakfast, and got fitted for their formal attire
  • Then they attended the Magic Items Showcase:
  • Magic Items Showcase
    • Defender Longsword (190)
    • Ruby Weave Gem (135)

sessions.title: Session 74 - The Grand Auction Part 4
sessions.content_html:
• We continued in the middle of the conversation with Lyra. An agreement could not be made, and both parties seem to want to place a bid on the music piece.
  • Selene became very suspicious of Tassarion, as he appears to be involved in some way, but both him and Morgan refuse to tell her more.
  • After the dinner, Morgan and Tassarion step out for a talk, and Selene uses this time to get completely plastered at the bar. Morgan talks to her and reconciles that she has to trust them.

  • Tomes and Grimoires Showcase

    • About 30 years ago, some mercenaries invaded his village, killed his wife and kidnapped his daughter

sessions.title: Session 75 - The Grand Auction Part 5
sessions.content_html:
• The next morning, the party had breakfast and made a plan for the Music showcase.
  • They decided that it would probably be best not to bid on the piece and sour relationship and proposition from Lyra.
  • The Music showcase was preceded by a performance from the legendary bard, musician, and performer Isadora Underhill, who has an item for sale featured in the showcase.

  • The only thing that remained was a note reading:
Come find me if you *actually* want to talk.

- Isadora <3
  • The party was promptly kicked out of the tavern following this altercation, and they went back to the hotel, with Voroth excited that he was able to get an autograph from Isadora.

sessions.title: Session 76 - The Grand Auction Part 6
sessions.content_html:
• Relics Showcase
    • Cicero's Coin of Two Fates - Flipping it can change fate and reality itself, but its true nature is unpredictable. (25)
    • Statue of Chronos forged in Mechanus by the Clockwork Angels (20)
    • The Toque of A'dam L'vine, Executive Chef of the 2 Gatekeeper Star restaurant "Buoys like Jagger" - Advantage on checks relating to cooking + Chef Feat (12)

    • Soulshackle Skull (175k)
    • Divine Magistrate's Embrace - (220k)

    • Tome of Clear Thought - (85k)
