  • After acquiring the items from the auction, the party met with Lyra on the floor one last time. Morgan again emphasized that he intends to kill Maris, and will do whatever it takes to achieve that. She responded saying Songbeard was not the idealized man Morgan thinks he is, and that the Swashbucklers may not take to his righteous cause like he thinks they might.
  • Following this discussion, the party set a course for Coastgate to find Selene's family so she could ask them for help with the ritual to imprison Transcendent Voroth. The party was extremely diligent to ensure they weren't being followed out to sea, since they just acquired nearly one million GP worth of items.
  • That night on the ship, Morgan had a vivid dream at sea on the Ship of Theseus alone in a terrible storm. Recognizing this dream as extremely similar to the vision he had when he first swore his oath to the God Corsair, he shouted to the sky asking for help and looking for answers.
  • These shouts went unanswered, as lightning struck down onto the ship, lighting the masts on fire, and jolting Morgan awake in his room.
  • Morgan stepped outside, to make sure the ship wasn't actually on fire and everything was in order. Before turning around and going to bed, however, he noticed a crack in the ships sleeping quarters, and peeked in to discover a cloaked figure standing above Selene.
  • After alerting the party, a small altercation took place, revealing the intruders as scared children. Before anyone got hurt, though, Their leader announced themselves from the Crow's nest and descended down to acknowledge defeat and apologize for the inconvenience.
  • Morgan, suspicious this person was sent by the swashbucklers, but Selene recognized the leader's voice as her Sister Erin.
  • After a surprising reunion, she ensures the rest of the party that she is here on personal business: She caught word that a group called "Melody's Tempest" had purchased almost a million GP worth of items, and wanted to score something for herself.
  • She also expresses disappointment with Selene and her disappearance from their family, saying things like "father is furious with you" and "When mother died a few years ago, you didn't even write us". Selene said she didn't even know these things occurred.
  • After catching up a bit, Erin asks if she can stay the night on their ship to spend more time with Selene before heading out, to which Morgan reluctantly agrees.
  • Everyone goes back to sleep with Selene and Erin having a slumber party like they used to when they were kids.

sessions.title: Session 77 - Enter Erin Otherday!
sessions.content_html:
• The next morning, Erin suggested to Selene that they return home together, since "father would probably be more accepting if I were there, too."
  • Together they make a plan to meet up after she completes the job she had started and the party arrives in Coastgate. Specifically they say they will meet up at "The Good" Gatekeeper's Inn.
  • Erin then teleports away with the children she was coaching, and the party continues sailing to Coastgate.
  • The night before arriving, Morgan has another dream much like the one a few days prior. It's darker in tone, highlighting a cold feelings coming over him with motifs of being bound. Then, he appears on a hill on what seems like the outskirts of Raeneros City. There is a headstone there as lightning strikes the grave, and he wakes up in a cold sweat.
  • As he get out of bed and immediately notices magical chains wrapped around his left forearm.
  • He goes to the rest of the party for help, with Selene eventually identifying the magic as being divine; Tassarion, however, kept insisting to remove his arm.
  • The party made their way to the tavern, and a few hours later, an excited Erin arrived wanting to celebrate completing her job.
  • A few drinks later, and she began to loosen up a bit. Tassarion began questioning her about her job where she eventually revealed that she was tasked with stealing some rare original music.
  • She wouldn't explicitly say, but accidentally heavily implied that it was the Sonnet Swashbucklers that hired her.
  • Selene and Erin stepped outside to give the party space to come up with a plan. Morgan then attempted to convince her to show him the piece. Eventually she did show him, but wouldn't let him touch it.
  • In a panic at that request, she teleported herself and Selene to the crime scene to prove where she got it from.
  • Unfortunately, that left them without the magical means to come back, so Selene and Erin had to hide out in the forest.
  • The next morning, Selene and Erin were able to talk one on one and clearly state intentions. She affirmed that whatever happens to her clients after her job is done is none of her concern, and insinuated to Selene that the party could use her for information on their location to land a surprise attack.
  • Erin then teleported them back and they agreed to meet up at their childhood home later that day.

sessions.title: Special - Ethiul's Final Acension
sessions.content_html:
Part 1: The Blindfold and Seeking the Spark

  • Ethiul has donned the blindfold. He is already extremely perceptive but it still has taken some time to get use to. He begins to interpret the familiar sounds of nature and day to day living differently, feeling the rustle of leaves and bushes, the wind as it brushes the snow, and the scents of a bustling town.
  • As he continues caring for the egg, Ethiul also heightens his senses around touch, feeling the pulsing ice-cold energy. But he feels stuck not being with his comrades; there is a sense of growing boredom from just caring for the egg, Ethiul convinces Soren to join him on an excursion into the Frostspire Glaciers to practice his magic.
  • Ethiul attempts to cast spells, but his magic feels fleeting in its usual ways. Additionally, with his blindfold, he is forced to rely on his heightened other senses. He perceives the immense, raw magical energy permeating the glacier. He feels its essence – a thrumming vibration, a faint, metallic taste in the air, an intense cold that carries strange, almost resonant frequencies.
  • Through this unique perception, Ethiul senses a concentrated point of this chaotic magic – a "Glacial Spark" – a small, pulsing nexus of raw, untamed arcane energy deep within the ice. It's too strong and wild for him to directly control, but its presence is undeniable. He intuitively knows this is a source of immense power.
  • Ethiul and Soren return, perhaps disheartened by his magical performance but invigorated by the new discovery. That night, Ethiul has a vivid dream. His sister, Seraphina, appears, still blindfolded.
"Brother, it seems you are having trouble channeling the stars. The moon's light, in its fullness, can obscure the true brilliance of the cosmos. Return to the Glacial Spark during the new moon. When the celestial veil is thinnest and the stars blaze brightest. Go alone, for this is a communion of your spirit with the universe."
  • She implies that the waxing gibbous moon (which will occur during his waiting period) is a time of growth and increasing power, preparing him for the climax of the new moon.
  • Ethiul intensifies his research into the lost rituals and accelerated growth. Now, he has a new piece of the puzzle: the Glacial Spark and the New Moon's influence.
  • He theorizes that he can combine the raw power of the Glacial Spark with the stellar channeling capabilities of the new moon to perform a modified version of the magical aging rituals he's been researching. This ritual would not just hatch the egg, but significantly accelerate its early growth, possibly granting it unique properties from the cosmic channeling.
  • During the weeks leading up to the new moon, Ethiul meticulously plans the ritual, practicing the specific somatic components blindfolded, deepening his connection to his new senses. Soren supports him throughout this period, helping him gather rare components necessary for the ritual in the wild.

Part 2: The New Moon Ritual and Ascension

  • On the night of the new moon, Ethiul, accompanied by the egg, journeys alone back to the Glacial Spark. The stars are incredibly vivid without the moon's light. Ethiul positions the egg at the heart of the Glacial Spark. He begins the complex ritual, channeling the raw energy of the spark and the cosmic power of the blazing stars directly into the egg.
  • As he reaches the climax, he intuitively unleashes a focused Call Lightning spell. However, instead of thunder and raw electricity, the sky above him shimmers with concentrated starlight, coalescing into a beam of pure cosmic energy that descends onto the egg. This isn't just a spell; it's a conduit for the universe's will.
  • The egg glows intensely, then cracks. A young white dragon emerges, but it's not merely a "Young White Dragon." Its scales shimmer with faint constellations, its eyes hold an unusual depth, and it seems to radiate a serene, almost celestial cold. This dragon is rapidly aging under the ritual's influence, growing larger and more capable before Ethiul's eyes. It now carries a unique blend of glacial essence and cosmic energy; the white scales have tinted with a faint cosmic purple/pink, each with unique bright spots that faintly twinkle like the night sky.
  • As the ritual concludes and the dragon solidifies in its accelerated state, Ethiul feels an undeniable pull – not physical, but spiritual. A shimmering portal, like a window to the cosmos, opens before him.

Part 3: Trials of the Council

  • Seraphina appears again, this time actually in the flesh:
"You have woven a new destiny, brother. Now, prove your understanding of balance." She takes Ethiul and the newly awakened, cosmic dragon into the Astral Plane.
  • Ethiul and Thurial appear before the Council of Cassiopeia. His final trial, the Trial of Truth begins:
  • Test of Intent (The Fool's Reckoning):
"Ethiul, you were once called 'The Fool' by another who observed countless timelines. Your sight was short, your actions often impulsive. How do you, as a Cosmic Vanguard, ensure your grand designs consider the far-reaching echoes of your choices, particularly when they involve altering the natural order, as you have with this creature?"
  • Test of Connection (Seraphina's Reflection):
"Your path was once solitary, detached even from those who cared for you. Your sister observed this. This creature you have nurtured, it is bound to you. How will you balance the deep personal bonds you forge, and the love you feel, with the impartiality and cosmic duty required of a Vanguard, especially when those bonds might clash with the greater good?"
  • Test of Destiny (The Wyrm's Path):
"This Star-Wyrm, born of ice and tempered by starlight, holds immense potential for both creation and destruction. While nurtured by your hand, it still carries ancestral shadows. What assurances can you offer that its power will be wielded for harmony? What future do you envision for it, independent of your immediate guidance, and what sacrifices are you willing to make to ensure it walks a righteous path, should it stray?"
  • The counsel sends Ethiul and Thurial back to the material plane to continue their training together. When he returns, his senses are expanded from 10ft to 30ft.

sessions.title: Session 78 - The Otherday's Home for Gifted Children
sessions.content_html:
• Selene entered the inn room to Morgan face down in a bucket with Tassarion comforting him.
  • She filled everyone in on the talk she has with Erin and reluctantly told everyone she is ready to go to her childhood home: "The Otherday's Home for Gifted Children".
  • Upon arriving at the orphanage, the party is greeted by two young children. Selene says she is a sister which prompts them to escort everyone upstairs to her father's office.
  • After a tense reunion with her Father, Selene said she's back because the party needs his help finding someone to cast a very powerful spell. His name is Justin Otherday.
  • Selene makes several remarks during the discussion about her distain for this place as she does not consider it home. She also makes several remarks about how she "had to get out of there".
  • Erin and Selene's brother Micah join the party for the meal in the cafeteria. Selene asked why they've stayed all these years.
  • Erin stayed because she works for "The Syndicate" and is their Father's favorite, serving basically as a right hand to him. Micah stayed because he is studying at the university while still living at home.
  • Justin makes an offer that he can find someone powerful enough to cast the ritual and imprisonment spell, but it will take a couple days negotiation and upwards of 20k Gold, but he can get someone fast.
  • After he leaves, the party make a plan with Erin to ambush the Sonnet Swashbucklers when she turns in the job. She seems intrigued by Selene and the party's intentions and with the potential magical capabilities of the music, and wants in.
  • She offers to help both with teleportation magic and scrying magic.
  • The transaction occurs, and the party executes an ambush by teleporting in.
  • This catches both captains: Captain Clarie Anne Nette, and Captain Presto Bassfinger extremely off guard, a fight ensues
  • Midway through the fight, an enlightened Ethiul descended hanging from a hatched astral-touched wyrmling.
  • This overwhelms them, and they are defeated by the full might of Melody's Tempest (and Erin). Morgan collects their skull keys, adding the total of his collection up to 4.
  • The ship they were fighting on got destroyed by the other ship, and Erin teleported the party out.
  • In the stress of the situation, she is unable to teleport back to the original rendezvous, and at first it seems like the party is in a remote location, but after finding some high ground, they realize that they are actually closer to Raeneros than they would have been otherwise.

sessions.title: Session 79 - Transcendent Showdown Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• The party entered Raeneros City and went up to the normal Gatekeeper's Inn to rest.
  • As they walked through the City, Ethiul described what had happened up north in the months everyone has been separated; they have become a fully realized Cosmic Vanguard.
  • The next day, every went to Bidrian's Biddings to visit Jobidrian, and introduce him to Erin. She ran off into the store to buy some shit.
  • The party caught him up on their progress collecting the works of Johann Sea-Bastion Bach, and he demonstrated excitement to hear the full Magnum Concierto soon.
  • After the visit with Jobidrian, the party traveled just outside the city to Melody's grave site. There, Morgan placed some flowers and asked for help. He said he was very unsure about how to approach the impending confrontation with his sister due to the many rising conflicts of interest. He said he feels lost and has been looking towards Corsair for guidance.
  • After this confession, Morgan sat beside her grade for a few more minutes before departing.
  • At the same time, Voroth ventured off to find a different grave site, but there was no grave at the location he went to.
  • The party eventually caught up to see him sitting on the ground chuckling to himself before standing up and joining everyone else.
  • Following this visit, the party decided to manually sail back to Coastgate to:
    • 1) Test out the new music piece they just acquired.
    • 2) allot Micah the time needed to find a powerful enough caster from the university to help Selene and the party with the Imprisonment ritual on Transcendent Voroth.
  • The night before reaching Coastgate, Morgan had another vision and heard stirrings of thunder outside. When he went outside to investigate he got mad, shouting at Corsair for doing absolutely nothing this whole time.
  • Upon this outcry, lightning from the storm strikes down into the ship directly onto Morgan, invigorating it with power, and finally unlocking the attunement. Corsair, has finally returned with his blessing.
  • Upon arriving back at the Otherday's Home for Gifted Children, the party met Dr. Möbius Bernoulli, a professor at Coastgate University and a very powerful ritual caster.
  • He spent a few hours explaining the imprisonment spell, its history, and how abjuration magic works in general.
  • Justin Otherday lead the party into the basement where everyone began setting up for the ritual.
  • Before being pinned down, Voroth asked Erin for a plan-b option, to which she handed him a vial of poison in case anything goes south.
  • The Ritual began, Dr. Bernoulli began casting the spell to which the party became enveloped in a veil of darkness.
  • A door appeared before them, everyone stared at it apprehensively before Selene decided to open it and walk through. This revealed a vast library of books and artifacts stretching through various maze like configurations from floor to ceiling.
  • A man in robes approached them. He is a bit timid and quiet, but revealed himself as Voroth the Curator.
  • He gave the party a task: To curate 5 of the 6 items presented into an exhibit for his library, but he wanted to be convinced why the curation was decided.
    • A Demon Tooth
    • A Brass Compass
    • A Chipped Cog
    • A White and Gold Decorative Egg
    • A Skull Key
    • A Green Dragon Scale.
  • Morgan suggested that many of the items reflect the adventures they have been together on, including the Compass, Cog, and Skull Key.
  • Voroth remarked that the Demon Tooth also fit into this classification from another one of his lifetimes (Transcendent Voroth's in Arc 1).
  • For the last item, Voroth picked the green dragon scale stating he felt more drawn to it, but could not elaborate on this further. This caused a cold, sinister energy to overcome the party before the environment around them faded to black, dealing necrotic damage.

sessions.title: Session 80 - Transcendent Showdown Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• The party next found themselves in an unfamiliar forest outside a cozy looking cabin. Inside, they met a version of Voroth called "Voroth the Alchemist". He asked them to find "lavender and Blueberry" in the forest.
  • Ethiul was able to use their improved perception to find lavender, but no one could find blueberries.
  • They did, however, spot a puppy in the forest which was very suspicious to everyone. Voroth cast the spell Tongues on the puppy so that it could understand common and they could communicate with it.
  • It appeared to be friendly, and the Puppy's name tag revealed to be "Blueberry."
  • Upon returning to the cabin, Voroth the Alchemist used the lavender to finish a puppy meal for his dog Blueberry.
  • An elderly woman, Voroth the Alchemists wife, came into the main room and offered the party pie, which most of them ate before the scene ended.
  • The party then appeared in an alleyway with a sociopathic Voroth dressed as a butcher. He presented them with two bound figures: a young boy and a powerful mage.
  • He forced the party to choose one to save: the boy or the woman, with the other being killed.
  • The party chose to save the young boy. Voroth promptly executed the woman, causing caused the scene to shift again.
  • In the next scene, the party appeared in on a stage, greeted by a new Voroth: "Voroth Vinny Vegas". He is the host of a game show about the campaign's past arcs/events. The party successfully answered all the questions, causing the scene to shift and avoiding more damage.
1. "For 100 points: This is the dimension of order, where rules are followed to a T and everything sits within a strict hierarchy!"** (Answer: What is Mechanus)
2. "For 200 points: This is the town where Voroth and Tassarion first met?" (Answer: Longdale)
3. "For 300 points: The name of the nautical musical that is extremely reminiscent of Morgan's Backstory?" (Answer: What is Gorman's Tragedy?)
4. "For the grand prize, what is going to happen next if you fail to imprison the great one: TTTTTRAAANSCENDENT VOOOOOROTHHH?" (Open ended answer - allow player creativity, perhaps hinting at madness, the multiverse unraveling, or Transcendent Voroth consuming PC Voroth's mind entirely).
  • The next scene placed the party in the ruins of a palace where they faced a conqueror-like Voroth: "Voroth the Conqueror" who espoused a philosophy of Social Darwinism.
  • Morgan and Ethiul engaged this Voroth in a philosophical debate, verbally decimating Vorath's worldview.
  • Voroth, enraged after being called "bald," rage quit and sent them to the final area.
  • The party entered the final area. Transcendent Vorath's voice tempted towards Selene to betray Voroth, but she immediately refused.
  • The party fought shadow versions of Voroth while Selene prepared the imprisonment ritual with the Soulshackle Skull.
  • Transcendent Voroth eventually appeared, knocking Tassarion into a sleep and approaching Selene and Voroth.
  • Right around when Selene finished the ritual (thanks to some stalling from Morgan), Transcendent Voroth cast his "domain expansion" capturing only Voroth.
  • The two Voroths shared a dialogue recalling days earlier an interaction they had in Raeneros near Melody's Grave site.
  • This vision transferred to the entire party as well and showed Voroth's own weakness where Voroth declared his realization; he realized he wasn't strong enough, but that his purpose was to empower the others he's traveled with to complete the job.
PC Voroth: "Voroth, back at the grave sight you showed me something."

*Cut back to when PC Voroth left to visit the other grave site. He looks down at a patch of grass where the grave should be. A gentle breeze whispers through the grass.*

PC Voroth: "Not here either, huh..."

T Voroth: "You don't know him. He never existed here. You'll only ever have the privilege of knowing him through *my* memories."

PC Voroth: "Even still, we loved him like our own brother."

*The wind stills. T Voroth physically manifests, a shimmering, malevolent counterpart, standing near the grave.*

T Voroth: "A want to show you something..." (Starts playing Mozart Requiem in D-minor)

*PC Voroth kneels, closes his eyes. The scene shifts instantly to a bustling market street in Raenaros City. A magician, resembling another version of Voroth stands on the street performing an act for a crowd. There are children surrounding him which show visual excitement for the tricks he is performing, witch the children resembling many of the other characters.

PC Voroth: "Voroth, I know better than anyone else that you aren't inherently evil. So why? Why play this game with my mind? What do you truly want?"

T Voroth: "I want you to know that you are insignificant. One of a million others. A data point... Only I am eternal. 

*The scene suddenly shifts to a nightscape. The houses from the town sit ablaze; bodies strewn about the plaza in pools of blood; the very children admiring Voroth's act, pierced with swords and arrows, burned, and massacred. Voroth slumps over them crying.*

T Voroth: "I want you to know that you are weak."

*T Voroth snaps his fingers causing the scene to shift again instantly. Classical music is playing as we see Morgan on his knees bound by chains. He faces up to a vengeful looking woman with glowing purple eyes. Ethiul, Selene, and Cleff lay dead, their bodies strewn beside Morgan. The two observe another Voroth, standing behind Morgan attempting to interrupt the ritual with a spell, but the magic from his wand crackles and fades; he is not strong enough to intervene. The woman draws a sword as she slowly approaches Morgan, beheading him in one sinister slash. His headless body collapses, and a flash of light erupts upon the completion of a ritual. A dark figure emerges beside the woman, and another man holding a baton joins her; they both kneel before it as the Voroth fades out of consciousness and the scene fades to black.*

T Voroth: "I want you to know that you need me. No matter how hard you try, you will never be strong enough to protect anyone."

*PC Voroth sits in silence and awe for a few minutes, and then suddenly begins smirking and chuckling upon his realization. Cut back to the battle.*

PC Voroth: " Every Voroth I've met, every memory I've shared... I've seen the awful things we've gone through. I've also seen the journeys we've been on. I've seen the people we've met, the things we've learned.

*PC Voroth draws a dagger dowsed with the poison Erin handed him.*

PC Voroth: I realized that our collective experience makes *you* who *you* are... Without us, you'd be nothing..."

T Voroth (Enraged): "Silence! I know what you're trying to do! The *only* way you can help your allies is with my power."

PC Voroth: " I also realized that you're right. I'm not strong enough, and I never will be. I can't protect them. But you assumed that I'm the one that's supposed to help. Other incredible mages exist, Voroth. So no, I don't need your power. Selene, take it from here.

T Voroth: "NOO"

*PC Voroth stabs himself with the dagger causing an eruption of energy, screeching with the sounds of  the souls that occupy Voroth's mind. They all flow into Selene as T Voroth Wretches in pain. Selene feels a surge of power and knowledge through her veins as everything warms up. You feel like you have the power to overcome. 

Selene: DOMAIN EXPANSION
  • He stabbed himself, releasing his power and memories into Selene, weakening Transcendent Voroth and allowing her to cast her own domain expansion to counter Transcendent Voroth's
  • The party attacked the weakened Transcendent Voroth, and Selene cast him into the imprisonment skull, completing the ritual.
  • LEVEL UP (15)

sessions.title: Session 81 - The Divine Magistrate's Embrace
sessions.content_html:
• The party slowly awakened on the floor of the ritual chamber in the Orphanage to Dr. Bernoulli, Erin, Micah, and Justin all watching closely with intent.
  • The professor told the party that Voroth is still alive, but still unconscious.
  • Eventually, when the party awakened him, he explained that the Voroth's who lived in the pursuit of power are always less prosperous than the ones that do. He also realized that their experience only contains the scenarios where Voroth is the one that fails to save the party, and therefore can never consider the realities where Voroth is never there. As a result, he severed his connection to the weave and gave his knowledge and power to his apprentice to finish the job he started.
  • After some heartfelt exchanges, Voroth declared his intentions to move to the outskirts of Raeneros City, and begin writing and publishing his knowledge from all the other Voroths.
  • Cleff offered Voroth 15,000 GP to help with moving to Raeneros City and establish himself, and Voroth thanked the party for everything, and ensured them that he will keep working to help.
  • Justin, declaring the effort a success, announced that he will hold a celebratory feast to commemorate Voroth's "Cure" and the return of Selene.
  • The Party rested for the night, and Morgan snuck off to ask his question to the Divine Magistrate's Embrace
  • The next day the party went to the southern markets to do some shopping while waiting for the feast. Morgan hung back at the Orphanage.
  • Selene went to a book store and purchased an elegant stationary set for Erin as a gesture saying she wants to stay in touch. She also purchased a graphic educational poster of the schools of magic and the weave for Micah.
  • Tassarion borrowed some funds from Cleff, and purchased 4,000 GP worth of diamonds.
  • The party returned to Morgan talking to Erin in the dining hall as the preparations for the feast were being completed.
  • Selene sat at the top of the room next to Erin and Justin. He proposed a toast to Voroth and the party for their successes and for bringing his daughter back. Selene said a few words, and presented the gifts to Erin and Micah before also begrudgingly thanking Justin for the help as well.
  • After the Feast, Morgan took Tassarion aside to another room, and told him again that he wants him to give up the ritual, this time proposing a deal: Tassarion gives up the ritual for good, and in exchange Morgan will tell him where his daughter is.

sessions.title: Session 82 - Who is Erin Otherday?
sessions.content_html:
• We began the session with Selene, Voroth, and Ethiul at the door having heard Morgan's insane proposal.
  • Morgan and Tassarion are in a tense standoff, as Morgan presents his proposal for the location of Tassarion's daughter, Maris.
  • After a tense and difficult deliberation, Tassarion accepts Morgan's offer, under 3 conditions:

1. Morgan must promise to help Tassarion rescue his wife.

2. Morgan must assist Tassarion in hunting down and eliminating every individual responsible for the attack on his family.

3. Morgan must aid Tassarion in dealing with the consequences of defying his Patron.

  • Tassarion hands over the Baton of Johann Sea-Bastion Bach and the other music pieces to Morgan, who secures them, and in exchange Morgan reveals that the "Divine Magistrate's Embrace" is a powerful artifact that bears the name "Otherday." The party realizes that Tassarion's daughter is none other than Erin Otherday, a revelation that shocks everyone.
  • With the new alliance and understanding, Tassarion confides more about his past and his patron, revealing that both him and Maris share the same patron: Davy Jones.
  • He also reveals that the ritual he has been preparing for is to be performed for him.
  • Shortly after this discussion there is a knock at the door which reveals Erin, who was looking for the party after they had been gone for a couple of hours.
  • Morgan and Selene take Erin to a secluded room to tell her the truth about Tassarion.
  • Erin immediately denies their claims, stating that she had visited her parents' gravesite and that her father's name was Terrance Everclear.
  • Morgan and Selene dismiss these lies and take Erin back to the main room to confront Tassarion.
  • Ethiul notices Erin's face begin to tremble as she struggles to maintain her denial.
  • The truth is finally revealed when Tassarion casts disguise self, transforming into his wife, who bears a striking resemblance to Erin.
  • Breaking down in tears, Erin apologizes for her confrontational and confused behavior, and she pleads with the party not to kill Justin.
  • Erin casts a spell to ensure the party's promise not to harm Justin. Everyone but Ethiul resists the spell, with Ethiul willingly failing the saving throw.
  • The session concludes with a heartfelt montage of Voroth packing up to travel to Raenaros.

sessions.title: Session 83 - Confronting Justin Otherday
sessions.content_html:
• The party has a send-off for Voroth, who plans to return to Raeneros to begin documenting the knowledge of the other Voroth's whose memories he experienced, and begin researching things about Davy Jones and the ritual to continue to support the party from afar.
  • Morgan and Selene confront Justin Otherday about his involvement with Erin's parents. Justin denied any wrongdoing, sticking to the same story Erin previously told the party about Terrence Everclear.
  • Morgan, frustrated by Justin's lies, attacks him. Justin retaliates by opening a trapped book containing five runes. The doors and windows of the office explode outwards, drawing a crowd and alerting the building.
  • Morgan miraculously passes all but one of the saving throws, using his Guarded Mind ability to deflect the final one. (There was a 0.67% chance of this outcome.)
  • Morgan uses a new spell from his magic gauntlet, Melody's Grasp, to bind Justin in spectral green chains that deal necrotic damage.
  • As Morgan interrogates the bound Justin, Tassarion and Ethiul hold back the growing crowd with a combination of deception and Ethiul's spectral monk arms.
  • Justin admits to Morgan and Selene that he was the one who placed the kidnapping request for Erin, but denies responsibility for her mother's death since he simply placed the hit and cannot control the actions of the assailants.
  • Erin arrives in a panic and pleads with Morgan not to harm Justin. Morgan, wanting Justin to confess to Erin, continues his torture. Justin, however, says his final farewell to Erin, expecting to die.
  • Tassarion, ashamed and unwilling to upset Erin, hangs his head. Morgan, growing more frustrated, casts Zone of Truth. Justin fails the save and, after being pressed, admits his actions.
  • Erin, deeply upset, asks if Morgan is satisfied and again pleads with him to let Justin go. Morgan releases him, storms out of the building, calling Tassarion a coward as he passes.
  • Erin rushes to Justin's to help him and Selene gives him a health potion to stabilize him. Everyone else leaves, while Erin stays behind to tend to Justin for a bit longer.
  • Later at the "Good" Gatekeeper's Inn, Tassarion and Selene are joined by Erin, and the three sit in a stunned silence. Selene and Tassarion apologize to Erin. Tassarion attempts to reconnect, stating he just wants to make things right with his family, but Erin coldly dismisses this, saying the family he longs for is just a fleeting memory that no longer exists.
  • After Erin leaves to get another drink, Selene reassures Tassarion, telling him to focus on the future and that he can't force a relationship with her.
  • Tassarion follows Selene's advice upon Erin's return, but Erin announces she needs to be alone and leaves the tavern.
  • At another Gatekeeper's Inn, Morgan expresses his frustration to Ethiul, lamenting that he feels he regressed by torturing Justin. He feels that everyone else's personal quests have been resolved while his has been put on the back burner. He feels especially let down by Tassarion's inaction. He also resents the fact that once Maris is dead, he will be without any family, while everyone else gets to reunion with theirs.
  • Ethiul doffs his cosmic blindfold to look Morgan directly in the eyes and reassures him that the party will support him and his quest. He imparts wisdom, and explains Morgan's strength and their dependence on him as a leader.
  • Tassarion and Selene arrive, and Selene realizes that this is actually the Good Gatekeeper's Inn, and Tassarion apologizes to Morgan, but Morgan states he doesn't believe him. Morgan declares that once Maris is dead, Melody's Tempest will be no more and that the party should go on their separate ways.

sessions.title: Session 84 - The Search for Maris Part 1
sessions.content_html:
• The next morning, the party had breakfast at the inn and discussing their next steps. Tassarion was seated in a booth already, exclaiming he spotted Erin near the Orphanage overlooking a bridge.
  • Erin lamented the complexity of the situation, and is thankful Tassarion didn't harm Justin. She also confides that she's very confused and just needs some time alone to process.
  • Following this, the party decided to track down Isadora to question her more about what happened in Tassarion's village.
  • Selene cast a sending spell, to which Isadora replied, requesting to meet them backstage after a show she was performing in the city of Diyun in two days.
  • The party made a plan to leave the following morning after Selene prepares a teleport spell.
  • In the meantime, they decided to visit the local university to find spells related to scrying to either find or learn more about Maris and her whereabouts.
  • On their way to the university, they encountered several people wearing red gnome hats and drinking. Selene recalls this must be an annual party event called Gnome-con.
  • Morgan approached a couple of the bros and asked for a drink. He was given a magical cup that automatically refilled with a foul-tasting, alcoholic liquid.
  • Selene tried a sip and coughed, prompting one of the bros to mock her for being old and lame.
  • Frustrated, Tassarion cast banishment on the man who was making fun of Selene. He dropped his magical cup, which Morgan then took.
  • The party continued to the University Bookstore, looking to purchase some items. Morgan then proceeded to get extremely drunk from having kept drinking from the cup. Selene, not wanting to deal with this also kept taking some swigs from her waterskin, which had been filled with a cup of the vile liquid as well.
  • Tassarion was able to end Morgan's intoxication by finding a "Pocari Sweat", and the party purchased several healing potions, two scrolls of scrying, and Selene bought a Hat of Wizardry, applying her university affiliated discount at checkout.
  • After shopping, they attended Dr. Mobius Bernoulli's office hours. He explained the mechanics of scrying and what they would need to make the spell successful.
  • Morgan didn't have anything belonging to Maris for the scrying spell, but he told him about the skull keys he had collected from the Sonnet Swashbucklers.
  • Dr. Bernoulli agreed to examine them, noting their magical properties, and said he might be able to find a way to use them to locate other copies or learn about them in general.
  • The party made plans to return to him after their meeting with Isadora, and headed back to the "Good" Gatekeeper's Inn to rest.

sessions.title: Session 85 - The Search for Maris Part 2
sessions.content_html:
• The next morning, the party made a plan during breakfast in the tavern. Selene cast a sending spell to Isadora, asking how they should find her. She replies giving them a password to tell security: "Sirion" - The name of the Tassarion's town she attacked all those years ago.
  • The party travels to the city of Diyun via a teleportation circle spell provided by Selene which they used at the university.
  • From there, they navigated to a checkpoint by giving the password, and were escorted to an area to leave behind their weapons and magic items. Morgan was really annoyed he had to Afterwards, they were escorted to a VIP box to watch Isadora's concert.
  • Morgan used the open bar at the concert to once again get exceedingly drunk.
  • After the show, they meet Isadora backstage accompanied by a few body guards.
  • She offers Tassarion information about her co-conspirators in exchange for them to agree to a magical pact which would grant her immunity from any pursuit by the party. The contract reads:

This magical pact, herein known as the “Accord of Isadora,” is hereby made and entered into on this day between Isadora Underhill, hereafter referred to as the Affiant, and the members of the faction known as Melody's Tempest.

The Affiant, Isadora Underhill, agrees to provide the following information regarding the incident of the Sirion kidnapping approximately thirty years ago: the full, truthful names of all involved parties, their known professions at the time, and their last known locations and activities. This information shall be inscribed upon the back of this scroll upon both party's signatures.

In exchange for this information, and upon both party's signatures, the Affiant is granted a magical covenant of non-interference. This covenant binds the following individuals, who have granted their consent and power to a single representative signatory:
- Morgan Songstrike
- Tassarion Lanthir
- Selene Starweaver
- Ethiul of the MoonStar Grove
- Voroth

The aforementioned individuals are bound to the following terms:
1. Cessation of Pursuit: They shall, from this moment forward, cease all direct pursuit of Isadora Underhill. This includes, but is not limited to, using their abilities, resources, or agents to track, locate, or harass her. 
2. Abandonment of Vengeance: They shall abandon any and all intentions of enacting personal vengeance upon Isadora Underhill for her role in the Sirion incident or any other past wrongdoing.
3. Non-Interference: They shall not interfere with the Affiant's life, business, or travels. This clause does not apply to a chance encounter where the Affiant is the aggressor or initiates an act of harm against a member of Melody's Tempest.

Should any signatory of Melody's Tempest knowingly and willingly break any of the terms of this Accord, the Affiant, Isadora Underhill, shall be granted an immediate and irrevocable magical recourse. The violating party's connection to the weave of magic shall be severed. They will suffer a permanent inability to cast spells, use magic items, or benefit from any magical effect that they did not create themselves, for a period of one hundred  years or 50% of their remaining lifespan, whichever is larger. The Affiant shall also be absolved of all duties and protections under this pact.

This contract is to be bound by the blood and will of all parties involved. By signing below, the full terms of the agreement and the magical consequences for its breach are acknowledged.

X__Isadora_Underhill_<3__
X__Tassarion_Lanthir_____
  • Tassarion agrees to these terms, and signs on behalf of the party.
  • A parchment appears in his pocket detailing the names and current statuses of the remaining conspirators:
    • Luc'a'pizza (alive); he runs a pizza shop on the north side of Coastgate called "Pizza Pizza".
    • Erenhardt (alive); he works on a farm associated with the village of Plowshire.
    • Brother Harold (alive); he lives in the slums on the south side of Coastgate.
    • Ace Maverick, as the party already knows, is deceased.
  • With this information acquired, the party teleports back to Coastgate and Morgan asks what they should do next.
  • Tassarion insists they prioritize Morgan's quest to confront Maris, stating that the other matters can wait.
  • The next day the party meets with Dr. Bernoulli at the university again, who reveals that the skull keys from the Sonnet Swashbucklers are magic fixtures that create entrances to a hidden, demiplane-like space.
  • Based on this, the party theorizes that Maris is likely hiding in a secret citadel accessible only with a skull key.

sessions.title: Session 86 - The Search for Maris Part 3
sessions.content_html:
• The next morning in the tavern, the party makes a plan. Selene casts sending to reach out to their allies from Whispering Pines for help.
  • They agree to meet in a few day's time in the port city of Saltmarsh near the Sea of Syncopation to ready for their trip.
  • Selene goes to find Erin. While she's gone, Morgan acknowledges Tassarion's efforts to help him, and they reconcile their tension at the realization that given Tassarion's actions, they're in this together now.
  • When Erin and Selene return, Erin apologizes for her anger towards everyone, and offers her help to Morgan and Tassarion, saying that all of these problems stem from her, and while she doesn't blame herself for the situation she's in, feels an obligation to make things right for her own sake.
  • She also says, facetiously, that she'll forgive Morgan once Maris has been dealt with and their problems are behind them.
  • The party then meets at the Gatekeeper's Inn with Ulrich, Fen, Calen, Soren, and Ulgrim. Morgan gives a rousing motivational speech to the group, recounting the journey they've been on together, looking towards finally finishing what they started.
  • After the speech, a strange frog-man named Vorth shows up, saying he's been following them trying to deliver a letter. The letter is from Voroth:
My Dearest Companions,

At this time you are likely at the precipice of your quest to defeat Maris. In my research I have learned the following about Johann Sea-Bastion Bach from Jobidrian and his libraries:

As you know, Bach's 'Magnum Concierto' contains the ritual used to seal a great evil, that which we've come to know as Davy Jones. The ritual is completed once the full Concierto has been performed at the ritual site. These works also recount the story of the conflict between his crew and Davy Jones; each movement a piece to the overarching narrative culminating with Movement 10 - Requiem of the Fallen - A lament of Bach's sacrifice for the cause.

Other documents I have found refer to Davy Jones as "The Pirate Lich". An extremely powerful and dangerous undead that feeds off the souls of the damned. If my assumptions are correct, then I believe Davy Jones' locker to be phylactery of souls, or the source of his power, and notably it is a power source that cannot be destroyed.

This would explain Bach's decision to seal Davy Jones rather than destroy him - because destruction was simply not an option. I surmise that Maris intends to play the Concierto backwards, reversing the effects of the seal thereby freeing Davy Jones. Once Maris is defeated the threat of Davy Jones still looms large. If there were some way to destroy Davy Jones' Locker, or free the souls of the damned from his influence, you could possibly destroy him, permanently.

I hope this information proves useful, I'm looking forward to a feast together soon. 

With love,

Voroth
  • Based on this information, Tassarion remarks that they should not try to destroy the locker, as there's a chance his wife's soul could be trapped there.
  • Nonetheless, the party heads to sleep. The next morning, they set sail for the center of the Sea of Syncopation. As they approach, they are greeted by several ships waiting for their arrival.

sessions.title: Session 87 - Entering The Pirate's Citadel
sessions.content_html:
• "This is what you get for trusting the wrong side, you will get nothing in the end." - DJ to Tassarion
  • The party arrived at the center of the Sea of Syncopation to find a large fleet of pirate ships guarding the entrance to the Pirate Citadel.
  • A massive battle erupted, with fireballs and powerful spells being cast by both sides.
  • Morgan began creatively rearranging barrels of alcohol and gunpowder on a lower ship deck, intending to use them as bombs.

sessions.title: Session 88 - Morgan Vs. Maris
sessions.content_html:
• Hustle and bustle in the city is an illusion which Ethiul notices
  • Encounter Maris in the town square
  • Conversation happens, Morgan wouldn't attack her right away. Morgan challenges her to a duel, and
  • You realize you've walked directly into my domain, you have no cards.
  • "We'll see brother" AOE explosions on everyone combat starts, real initiative.

Phase 1:

    • Soprano Swiftfoot + 6 pirate captains 2 rounds

Phase 2:

    • Maris appears levitating and reveals the baton, more combat while all pirates surrounding the area play the Song of Corsair's Curse
    • 2-3 rounds of combat-ish
    • Charisma save Disadvantage: Hands grab party, ethiul blah blah, morgan uses guarded mind to resist the effects and casts the chains on Maris

Phase 3:

  • Morgan feigns capture, but uses guarded mind (pretend it's an idea) Chains in the air to pull her out of the sky
  • Release them or I'll kill you. No you were going to kill them anyway
  • Stabbed, con breaks the chains and let go of maris, and maris is free
  • Morgan goes to 0 from the poison, rain starts
  • Lyra says something cocky
  • Everyone gets one round to act in soft initiative
  • Divine Intervention
  • The necrotic shit on the floor dissipates
  • +50 HP to everyone

Morgan and Melody:

  • Are you sure you want to do this? I was there when you made your oath. Your vow dictated that you would kill the people responsible for her death and the death of your family. Nobody killed Maris, and she's still your family.
  • Here's the thing, that's not Maris, my sister died years ago. This monster is the one who kill my father and the one that killed you. This monster inhabits my sister's corpse.
  • You're not my sister, it's time to put you to rest. This isn't you and I'm sorry for what's happened. However, Maris, if part of you is still in there, then I'm going to finish this, He corrupted you, a child, say hi to dad for me.

Script

As Morgan looks down, a blade phases into reality. First cold, then turning warm with the blood that is beginning to pool, a singular breath hits the back of Morgan's neck. "If only you had listened, I warned you this would happen." As the blade is ripped out, her invisibility ends, Morgan drops to his knees and Lyra Strumming's, the last captain of the Sonnet Swashbucklers, appears. As the chains around Maris begin to drop, she turns her commander nods, and then turns to the rest of the party and bows. Eerily, she has perfectly copied the bow Morgan did before diving off the ship last session, almost as if she was watching, somehow.

" spits on Morgan that's for Soprano and everyone else you and the mighty "Melody's Tempest" butchered"

The rain begins to fall as Morgan slumps and falls onto the ground. Morgan you are down.

The rain intensifies, thunder rolling overhead. Fluttering in and out of consciousness, Morgan, you see Maris unsheathing her sword and making her way toward you. "I'll be honest brother this is rather disappointing, I thought you'd put up more of a fight than this. Well no matter, father died a worthless death, and I guess it figures that you would too."

Morgan, slowly sitting up locks eyes with his sister. "I've faced death before, I am not afraid of you."

Maris: "You should have been, any last words?", Maris ready's her action, and raises her sword.

Morgan: "Just do it you fucking coward". Morgan's head drops down as he mutters a silent prayer, "Corsair, aid me once more... My life is yours."

As the sword drops, Morgan your life flashes before your eyes, memories from all different ages of your life, playing with your sister as a child, meeting the party, finding the treasure, the ship, having drinks. All the good moments. For the first time, you come to peace with the fact that maybe, you weren't meant to win. Abruptly however, the memories stop, with a bone chilling voice calling out to you: "Not yet."

Your eyes are jolted awake, the world around you has stopped, the rain materializes as drops of water in the sky, the howling winds non-existent. In front of you stands a singular cloaked figure, you've seen this figure once before, years ago when you swore yourself to him. Corsair.

"Morgan, you're right. You've bared the storms, you've fought in my name, you've bled, you've carried my freedom, my name, your vengeance and the chaos of this world. You've stowed away betrayal and conquered situations meant to spell your demise. Yet despite it all, you remain devout. I chose you to be my champion, not just because of your mission and devotion, but because of your potential, and what you have been destined to do. Your mission has never been just to achieve your vengeance, you and I both know you are meant to do more. "

Although his face is cloaked, somehow you can tell he is smiling upon you.

"Morgan, you will not die here today. You've been loyal, accept this gift. Go forth and conquer this battle, as your greatest trial still lie ahead, you will know what must be done. You both have earned this for your devotion. Let her remind you that your life must not be one pure sacrifice."

The world speeds back up and BANG, lightning strikes down onto Maris's sword sending her backwards.

"AGH" A heavy fog rolls into the battlefield, lightning begins striking all around you, providing flashes of light where you can see all within. Slowly, you see a single figure rise amongst the darkness, Morgan. A fiery green billowing from his eyes, and his chains glowing brighter and brighter. He turns back to you all, and says, "Slaughter them all."

Screaming out, Morgan dives his fist into the ground, and in a flash of light, the tide turns. Shooting up from the ground around every single person are green ethereal chains. They wrap up around all of the enemies first, cinching around them with such force that they are driven to their knees. Around all of you, the chains swirl, attacking the black hands around you, and dissolving them into mist. The chains also wrap around your wounds, quickly closing them before shooting back into the ground. All of you heal 50hp.

Ethiul, in this moment of magical surge, you look up to see the sky open up and the cosmos beckon out to you. You have the ability to redon the blindfold.

(Randomly during round of initiative for rest of party)

As you intend to attack this target, suddenly, a huge gust of wind bursts in front of you, and the enemy is struck by lightning. Can you make a perception check?

On pass:

For only a split second you saw it, but it almost looked like some sort of winged being struck your target? Is there someone in the storm?

(Morgan turn / end of combat)

Morgan, watching your companions bring down your foes, you feel a surge of energy. Your body twitches, as a speed you have never felt before washes over you. These waves pulse through your body like lightning, your mind steadies as you become the storm. Blitzing around the battlefield, Morgan you strike down foe after foe, with each one your rapier and chains growing brighter and brighter. Each strike fills their bodies with more and more energy, some coinciding with strikes of lighting. As the wicked fall the grip on the others tighten. With more your focus being released as each crewmate gets sent to hell, the chains tighten around the others. As this happens however, you notice a blur moving at the same speed as you, one that is all too familiar. This blur seems to be attacking the same targets as you, with some you getting the final blow on, and others, they are.

As his bloodlust cools, Morgan comes to an halt. All that remain before you are Lyra and Maris. Lyra is on her knees, covered in chains, while Maris leans against the statue of Johann Seabastian Bach, stunned at what has occured.

Lyra pleads, "GET THESE THINGS OFF OF ME. Morgan, listen to me, if I had known that-"

"Silence." Almost as if materializing from the storm itself, just like how Morgan appeared. A woman stand before you. Two angelic wings have sprouted from her back since the last time you saw her. She wields a rapier given to her by Corsair himself. Younger than she was the last time you saw her, she turns and smiles towards first, Morgan. Then to the party.

"Mother." Morgan nods. Acknowledging Melody Songstrike, the wraith of the storm.

"It's good to see you son. Corsair sent me to-"

"GET THESE THINGS OFF ME. YOU DIED, WE WENT AND TOOK YOUR BODY SO THAT YOU COULDN'T COME BACK-"

Without saying a word, Melody walks over to Lyra while she cries.

"But you died-"

"I said silence."

And without saying another word, Lyra pulls a flintlock pistol off her hip, pushes it to Lyra's head. And executes Lyra. The bullet, bright white, lets out a sharp ringing noise. As Lyra slumps to the ground, her head, originating from the bullet, begins to flake away. This sensation moves slowly down her body, as she fades out of existence.

Maris stands and screams, "Don't you come any closer". But just as quickly as she stood, the chains wrap around her once more. Before they were a radiant green with a nefarious energy around them, now they seem slightly different, not as hate driven, more holy.

Morgan turns back to the party, his eyes still glowing brightly, but slowly fading to the point you can see his pupils. "Is everyone alright?"

Add a pause here to allow RP with the party members and Morgan/ Melody

Maris: "So this is it? Shackled like a dog before the dutiful son and his ghost of a mother? You came to kill me, so just get it over with."

Melody: "Morgan. You are not bound to this act. Justice is not vengeance. Mercy is not weakness. Whatever you choose… let it be because you see clearly, not because you are blinded by rage.”

Morgan: "Mercy? Rage? No… what I feel now is clarity. This woman before me is not the sister I loved. That girl died long ago, the day Father fell, and the day that she let Davy Jones corrupt her. What remains is a shell, twisted by greed and hunger for power.”

Maris (snarling, straining against the chains):

"LIAR. I am more alive than I ever was when I wore that fragile mask of ‘sister.’ I shed weakness. I carved my own destiny. Power is not corruption, Morgan — it is liberation! And you… you are still a slave. To gods, to oaths, to dead family.”

Morgan: "No. That sort of power that consumes the soul is not freedom. Your God, Davy Jones. Derives his power from damned souls. If only you saw that you are a damned soul yourself."

Maris: "Hypocrite. You call me corrupted, but you are no less dependent - no less bound than I am. You beg to Corsair, praying for the scraps of his storm."

Melody: “Dependency is not corruption, Maris. There is strength in bonds freely chosen, in love freely given. Morgan stands with others because he chooses to. You stand alone because you burned every bridge, mistaking ashes for a crown.”

Maris (eyes burning with frustration, voice faltering):

“You don’t understand. Power is all that lasts. Love fades. Bonds break. Family… family betrays you.”

Morgan:

"No Maris. YOU betrayed family. You chose this path. Don't pretend that the world made you this way. Father chose me for the treasure, and I can acknowledge that father never treated the two of us fairly. I'm sorry for that. But I never hurt you, I always loved you, and always was on your side. You simply gave into temptation and tried to get me killed. I've always been your biggest supporter, not Father, not Davy Jones, yet you threw me away. You're the reason we are who we are. We could have had normal lives if not for you."

Maris goes silent, staring at him, defiant, but for the first time, uncertain.

Morgan: "Maris, I don't know how much of you, my sister is still in there, but hear these words. I swear it ends here. By Corsair's storm, by Father's blood, by the damned souls affected by both our actions - I make this oath. Never again will Davy Jones twist another soul as he twisted yours. Never again will his chains drag the innocent into darkness. He tricked you, he used you and he manipulated you into what you have become. I am so sorry I could not protect you from him, I will live with that the rest of my life. I forgive you, and I hope you can find peace in knowing that I will end it. Your corruption may die with you, but your his reach dies with me."

For the first time Maris's face softens, somber, yet appreciative. Tears welling in her eyes.

"May the afterlife be kind to you, and may father hold you once again."

There is a moment, however small, where the two see eye-to-eye. Maybe in another life they were friends, and were able to work things out as children. A life where they both were happy. Davy Jones however prevented that.

Morgan quickly and with precision plunges his rapier into Maris's heart. The chains drop, and Morgan drops his rapier. He kneels next to his sister, and holds her as she passes.

sessions.title: Session 89 - Davy Jones Locker
sessions.content_html:
• Maris has the dark baton, +2 studded leather armor
  • Davy Jones Locker / Finale
  • Evil corrupt versions of the pirate captains (Austin Otto, Brian Teyy, and Presto Bassfinger)
  • Also evil corrupt Ace Maverick, Songbeard, and Maris
  • Tassarion's form dissipates into motes of light that envelop his wife's spiritual form. Her eyes open, filled with a mixture of confusion and wonder. Tassarion, now an etherial representation of himself, looks back at the party as he ascends; she is resurrected in the Material Plane.
  • Jobidrian has the ring of ram in his shop, Selene gets bracers of defense and the robe of the archmage
As the last note of Bach's Encore fades, you are all left standing in silence as the souls from Davy Jones' Locker continue peacefully walking through the gates as they ascend upwards. Their forms change from a dark ghostly green to a serene, silvery-white glow as they move past the threshold. This is the endless parade: a final, beautiful procession.

Within the march you all see a man in ornate seafaring attire appears, his magnificent beard sculpted in the shape of a duplet eighth note. He holds hands with a little girl in a beautifully flowing dress. As his head turns back he locks eyes with Morgan, a proud smile on his face. The girl looks up at Morgan, too. Her smile is innocent, like a light that was never touched, never corrupted by the darkness of the Locker. They both turn back to face the exit and walk free; their souls liberated.

Selene, your gaze locks onto two spirits that stand on the opposite side of the procession. They are a man and a woman embracing hand-in-hand facing towards you. They both bear a gentle but proud look. They are proud that the little girl they once knew has grown into a woman who has not only carved her own destiny, but empowers others to do the same.

Tassarion, as you lower your the baton and look out at the sea of souls marching towards the gate, your gaze catches a nostalgic, familiar face. For the first time in 30 years, Eladria stands before you, still, facing against the flow of walking. Her form shimmers, fragile and spectral, yet unmistakable.

Tassarion's Choice

At this point Tassarion has two options:

1) You may take Erin's hand and together embrace Eladria's saved spirit together, as a family, for the first and only time. Her Spirit is saved and she is at peace; she will ascend and rest eternally.

2) You may doff your robes and reach out your right hand towards Eladria. Doing so will trigger a ritual allowing you to use your magic to swap places with her soul. This will resurrect her, but at the cost of Tassarion's life.

Script

Erin: "You did everything you could, Dad.."

A shimmering, golden radiance begins to emanate from Tassarion's very core. He extends his right hand towards Eladria's spirit, and from his fingertips, golden threads of emerge. They wisp and sparkle through the air, luminous against the ghostly green of the Locker, and anchor themselves to Eladria's spirit. The golden light pours into Eladria, and her shimmering, ethereal form becomes more opaque as it begins to solidify.

As her form continues to materialize, you all realize that this golden light is not being restored, but rather it is being transferred. Tassarion's body begins to shed. His skin loses its color, and his hair turns to ash as his form becomes translucent, dissipating into motes of golden light that stream down the threads and into his wife's spirit.

For Erin, the realization begins to set in. "Wait!" she cries out, rushing forward. Her hands grasping towards his for a hold. But her fingers meet only sparks of light as they disperse around the motion of her arm—the last remnants of her father's physical form.

Tassarion, now a luminous echo of himself, turns to face the party. You eyes Tassarion, though without substance, meet Erin's with tears welled in her eyes.

Pauses to Tassarion the opportunity to say his final words.

Tassarion turns his head towards the exit, and a serene smile etches itself onto his face. His spirit, now a silvery-golden beacon, joins the silent, joyous march of ascending souls.

As his spirit disappears into the distance, Eladria's new body collapses. She takes a deep, gasping breath as she pushes herself up. Her hand trembles as she reaches into the empty space where he stood. Her gaze, a mix of dawning grief and profound awe, lifts to meet Erin's. A mother and daughter stare at each other—one reborn, the other hollowed by loss. The world shatters and mends itself in an instant. It is a testament to a father's sacrifice, and a promise that these final words will never be forgotten.

Tassarion's Letter

To the members of Melody’s Tempest,

If you're reading this, it is likely that I have paid the price for my involvement with Davy Jones, and my and my decision to defy his wishes. I have committed atrocities and transgressions during my time bound to him, that which I neither expect nor ask for forgiveness of. However, while our time together, as a group, was short, I leave behind my final expression of gratitude to you all.

To Ethiul,

Your wisdom and guidance has been a tremendous help, not just for me, but for all of us. You have been our moral compass: keeping us on the right path, keeping our dynamic in balance, and helping all of us see each other and ourselves in a new light. I don’t know what would’ve happened if you weren’t there when we all needed you the most.

To Voroth,

It fills me with great joy knowing that you are able to live out the rest of your days to their fullest after defeating Transcendent Voroth. I'm very grateful I was able to play a part in saving you from such a terrible fate. In doing so, you and the many versions of you have taught me that perfection and power are overrated; you were very wise to choose peace and love in its stead.

To Morgan,

The two of us were certainly a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield! I know we've had our differences in the past, and occasionally were even at odds with one another, but through all the turmoil it was you who showed me the error of my ways. I truly cannot thank you enough for the sacrifices you made on my behalf, and what that has given me—you brought my daughter back from the dead... There is an ancient proverb from the sages that read: "It is only during the hardest time where your true friends reveal themselves", and I think it speaks for itself.

To Selene,

I cannot express with the words on these pages what you have done for me. For your counsel, for your patience, and most importantly, for the way you’ve stood by Erin when I could not. Seeing how you two interact has made me realize that she isn’t alone—that she’s never been alone. When I see the bond you share with Erin, it feels as though a part of me has been given back. You remind me of the daughter I lost for so long, and because of that, I cannot help but see you as my own.

I trust you, wholly and without hesitation. Not just to guard her life, but to keep her spirit safe, and to make sure she never forgets who she is. I could ask for nothing greater than that—and I know you will not fail her. For whatever my trust and love are worth, they are yours. You carry them with you now, as surely as you walk beside her.

And lastly, to my beloved daughter, Erithyl,

I'm sorry that I couldn't be there when you needed me most. I missed the sound of your laughter, the chance to watch your steps grow steady, the privilege of telling you I was proud of the person you would become.

I cannot give you an answer as to why all this had to happen, but know this: not a single day passed when you were not somewhere in my thoughts, hoping that one day you might understand the depth of my love.

What I hope for is that you remember me not as a ghost from a life that never was, but as a man who has loved you fiercely from the moment you were born. If there is a trace of me that remains, let it be in the strength you carry, in the compassion that shines through your choices, in the courage that I know beats within you.

Though I cannot walk beside you now, I am with you at every sunrise, in the hush of starlight, in the breath you draw when the world is too heavy. And when your own journey one day brings you to the edge of the unknown, know that you will not cross it alone.

With a love beyond the reach of death,

Tassarion
